meta.blurb_uz: Yosh olim Viktor Frankenshteyn hayot sirini kashf etib, o'lik moddadan inson yaratadi — va o'z ijodidan dahshatga tushib, uni tashlab qochadi. Yolg'iz, rad etilgan maxluq esa avval mehr, keyin qasos izlaydi. Shimoliy qutb muzlari orasida dengizchi Uolton bu ikkovining fojiali hikoyasini eshitadi.
meta.why_uz: Birinchi ilmiy fantastik roman deb hisoblanadigan bu asar 200 yildan beri bir savolni beradi: ilm chegarasi qayerda va yaratuvchi o'z yaratganiga nimadan qarzdor? Maktublar, hikoya ichidagi hikoya va ehtirosli monologlar — C1 darajasidagi boy, adabiy ingliz tilini o'rganish uchun ajoyib matn.
meta.author_uz: Meri Shelli (1797–1851) — ingliz yozuvchisi, faylasuf Uilyam Godvin va feministik mutafakkir Meri Uolstonkraftning qizi, shoir Persi Shellining rafiqasi. «Frankenshteyn»ni 1816-yilda, 18 yoshida, Jeneva ko'li bo'yida Bayron bilan tuzilgan «arvoh hikoyalari» bahsi uchun yoza boshlagan; roman 1818-yilda nashr etilgan.

paras.en: To Mrs. Saville, England.
paras.uz: Angliya, Saville xonimga.

paras.en: St. Petersburgh, Dec. 11th, 17—.
paras.uz: Sankt-Peterburg, 11-dekabr, 17—.

paras.en: You will rejoice to hear that no disaster has accompanied the commencement of an enterprise which you have regarded with such evil forebodings. I arrived here yesterday, and my first task is to assure my dear sister of my welfare and increasing confidence in the success of my undertaking.
paras.uz: Sen shunchalik yomon xavotirlar bilan qaragan ishimning boshlanishi hech qanday falokatsiz o'tganini eshitib, quvonsang kerak. Kecha bu yerga yetib keldim va birinchi vazifam — aziz singlimni sog'-salomat ekanimga va ishimning muvaffaqiyatiga ishonchim tobora ortib borayotganiga ishontirish.

paras.en: I am already far north of London, and as I walk in the streets of Petersburgh, I feel a cold northern breeze play upon my cheeks, which braces my nerves and fills me with delight. Do you understand this feeling? This breeze, which has travelled from the regions towards which I am advancing, gives me a foretaste of those icy climes. Inspirited by this wind of promise, my daydreams become more fervent and vivid. I try in vain to be persuaded that the pole is the seat of frost and desolation; it ever presents itself to my imagination as the region of beauty and delight. There, Margaret, the sun is for ever visible, its broad disk just skirting the horizon and diffusing a perpetual splendour.
paras.uz: Men allaqachon Londondan ancha shimoldaman va Peterburg ko'chalarida yurarkanman, yonoqlarimni sovuq shimol shabadasi siypalayotganini his qilaman, u asablarimni tetiklashtirib, meni zavqqa to'ldiradi. Bu tuyg'uni tushunasanmi? Men yo'l olayotgan o'lkalardan esib kelgan bu shabada menga o'sha muzli iqlimlardan oldindan ta'm totdiradi. Va'dalarga to'la bu shamoldan ruhlanib, xayollarim yanada qizg'in va yorqin bo'lib boradi. Qutb sovuq va xarobalik maskani ekaniga o'zimni ishontirishga behuda urinaman; u xayolimda doimo go'zallik va zavq o'lkasi bo'lib gavdalanadi. U yerda, Margaret, quyosh hamisha ko'rinib turadi, uning keng gardishi ufqni zo'rg'a yalab o'tib, abadiy nur sochadi.

paras.en: There—for with your leave, my sister, I will put some trust in preceding navigators—there snow and frost are banished; and, sailing over a calm sea, we may be wafted to a land surpassing in wonders and in beauty every region hitherto discovered on the habitable globe. Its productions and features may be without example, as the phenomena of the heavenly bodies undoubtedly are in those undiscovered solitudes. What may not be expected in a country of eternal light? I may there discover the wondrous power which attracts the needle and may regulate a thousand celestial observations that require only this voyage to render their seeming eccentricities consistent for ever. I shall satiate my ardent curiosity with the sight of a part of the world never before visited, and may tread a land never before imprinted by the foot of man.
paras.uz: U yerda — chunki, singlim, ruxsatingga ko'ra, mendan oldingi dengizchilarga biroz ishonaman — u yerda qor va ayoz quvilgan; va sokin dengiz bo'ylab suzib, biz yer yuzida shu paytgacha kashf etilgan har qanday o'lkadan mo''jiza va go'zallikda ustun turadigan yurtga yetib borishimiz mumkin. Uning tabiati va qiyofasi, o'sha kashf etilmagan yolg'izliklardagi osmon jismlarining hodisalari kabi, tengsiz bo'lishi mumkin. Abadiy nur mamlakatida nimani kutib bo'lmaydi? Balki men u yerda kompas milini tortadigan ajoyib kuchni kashf etarman va g'alati ko'ringan jihatlarini abadiy tartibga solish uchun faqat shu safarni talab qiladigan mingta osmon kuzatuvini to'g'rilarman. Ilgari hech kim bo'lmagan dunyo qismini ko'rib, qizg'in qiziquvchanligimni qondiraman va ilgari hech qachon inson izi tushmagan yerni bosishim mumkin.

paras.en: These are my enticements, and they are sufficient to conquer all fear of danger or death and to induce me to commence this laborious voyage with the joy a child feels when he embarks in a little boat, with his holiday mates, on an expedition of discovery up his native river. But supposing all these conjectures to be false, you cannot contest the inestimable benefit which I shall confer on all mankind, to the last generation, by discovering a passage near the pole to those countries, to reach which at present so many months are requisite; or by ascertaining the secret of the magnet, which, if at all possible, can only be effected by an undertaking such as mine.
paras.uz: Meni jalb qiladigan narsalar shular va ular xavf yoki o'limdan har qanday qo'rquvni yengishga va bu mashaqqatli safarni bolaning bayram do'stlari bilan kichik qayiqqa o'tirib, ona daryosi bo'ylab kashfiyotga chiqqandagi quvonchi bilan boshlashga yetarli. Lekin bu taxminlarning hammasi noto'g'ri bo'lib chiqqan taqdirda ham, men qutb yaqinidan hozir yetib borish uchun ko'p oylar kerak bo'ladigan mamlakatlarga yo'l ochib, yoki magnitning sirini aniqlab — agar bu umuman mumkin bo'lsa, faqat menikidek ish orqali amalga oshishi mumkin — butun insoniyatga, oxirgi avlodgacha, keltiradigan bebaho foydamga e'tiroz bildira olmaysan.

paras.en: These reflections have dispelled the agitation with which I began my letter, and I feel my heart glow with an enthusiasm which elevates me to heaven, for nothing contributes so much to tranquillise the mind as a steady purpose—a point on which the soul may fix its intellectual eye. This expedition has been the favourite dream of my early years. I have read with ardour the accounts of the various voyages which have been made in the prospect of arriving at the North Pacific Ocean through the seas which surround the pole. You may remember that a history of all the voyages made for purposes of discovery composed the whole of our good Uncle Thomas’ library. My education was neglected, yet I was passionately fond of reading. These volumes were my study day and night, and my familiarity with them increased that regret which I had felt, as a child, on learning that my father’s dying injunction had forbidden my uncle to allow me to embark in a seafaring life.
paras.uz: Bu mulohazalar maktubni boshlagandagi hayajonimni tarqatib yubordi va yuragim meni osmonga ko'taradigan ishtiyoq bilan yonayotganini his qilaman, chunki aqlni hech narsa qat'iy maqsad — ruh aqliy nigohini qadashi mumkin bo'lgan nuqta kabi tinchlantirmaydi. Bu ekspeditsiya yoshlik yillarimning sevimli orzusi edi. Men qutbni o'rab turgan dengizlar orqali Shimoliy Tinch okeaniga yetib borish umidida qilingan turli safarlar haqidagi hikoyalarni ishtiyoq bilan o'qiganman. Esingda bo'lsa kerak, mehribon Tomas amakimizning butun kutubxonasi kashfiyot maqsadida qilingan barcha safarlar tarixidan iborat edi. Ta'limimga e'tibor berilmagan, lekin men o'qishni jon-dilimdan sevardim. Bu jildlar kechayu kunduz mening darsligim edi va ular bilan tanishligim bolaligimda otamning o'lim oldidagi vasiyati amakimga meni dengizchilik hayotiga kirishimga ruxsat bermaslikni buyurganini bilganimda his qilgan afsusimni yanada kuchaytirdi.

paras.en: These visions faded when I perused, for the first time, those poets whose effusions entranced my soul and lifted it to heaven. I also became a poet and for one year lived in a paradise of my own creation; I imagined that I also might obtain a niche in the temple where the names of Homer and Shakespeare are consecrated. You are well acquainted with my failure and how heavily I bore the disappointment. But just at that time I inherited the fortune of my cousin, and my thoughts were turned into the channel of their earlier bent.
paras.uz: Bu xayollar ruhimni sehrlab, osmonga ko'targan shoirlarni birinchi marta o'qiganimda so'nib ketdi. Men ham shoir bo'ldim va bir yil o'zim yaratgan jannatda yashadim; Gomer va Shekspir nomlari muqaddaslangan ibodatxonada men ham joy olishim mumkin deb tasavvur qildim. Muvaffaqiyatsizligimni va umidsizlikni qanchalik og'ir ko'targanimni sen yaxshi bilasan. Lekin aynan o'sha paytda amakivachchamning boyligi menga meros qoldi va fikrlarim yana avvalgi moyilligi o'zaniga burildi.

paras.en: Six years have passed since I resolved on my present undertaking. I can, even now, remember the hour from which I dedicated myself to this great enterprise. I commenced by inuring my body to hardship. I accompanied the whale-fishers on several expeditions to the North Sea; I voluntarily endured cold, famine, thirst, and want of sleep; I often worked harder than the common sailors during the day and devoted my nights to the study of mathematics, the theory of medicine, and those branches of physical science from which a naval adventurer might derive the greatest practical advantage. Twice I actually hired myself as an under-mate in a Greenland whaler, and acquitted myself to admiration. I must own I felt a little proud when my captain offered me the second dignity in the vessel and entreated me to remain with the greatest earnestness, so valuable did he consider my services.
paras.uz: Hozirgi ishimga qaror qilganimga olti yil o'tdi. Hatto hozir ham o'zimni bu buyuk ishga bag'ishlagan soatni eslay olaman. Men tanamni mashaqqatlarga o'rgatishdan boshladim. Kit ovchilari bilan Shimoliy dengizga bir necha marta bordim; sovuq, ochlik, tashnalik va uyqusizlikka o'z ixtiyorim bilan chidadim; kunduzi ko'pincha oddiy matroslardan ko'proq ishlardim, kechalarimni esa matematika, tibbiyot nazariyasi va dengiz sarguzashtchisi eng ko'p amaliy foyda olishi mumkin bo'lgan tabiiy fanlar sohalarini o'rganishga bag'ishlardim. Ikki marta Grenlandiya kit ovlash kemasiga kichik shturman yordamchisi bo'lib yollandim va o'zimni a'lo darajada ko'rsatdim. Tan olishim kerakki, kapitanim menga kemadagi ikkinchi lavozimni taklif qilib, xizmatlarimni shunchalik qadrlagani uchun qolishimni astoydil iltimos qilganida, biroz g'ururlandim.

paras.en: And now, dear Margaret, do I not deserve to accomplish some great purpose? My life might have been passed in ease and luxury, but I preferred glory to every enticement that wealth placed in my path. Oh, that some encouraging voice would answer in the affirmative! My courage and my resolution is firm; but my hopes fluctuate, and my spirits are often depressed. I am about to proceed on a long and difficult voyage, the emergencies of which will demand all my fortitude: I am required not only to raise the spirits of others, but sometimes to sustain my own, when theirs are failing.
paras.uz: Endi, aziz Margaret, qandaydir buyuk maqsadni amalga oshirishga loyiq emasmanmi? Hayotim farovonlik va hashamatda o'tishi mumkin edi, lekin men boylik yo'limga qo'ygan har qanday vasvasadan shon-shuhratni afzal ko'rdim. Qaniydi, qandaydir dalda beruvchi ovoz «ha» deb javob bersa! Jasoratim va qat'iyatim mustahkam; lekin umidlarim o'zgarib turadi va ruhim ko'pincha tushkunlikka tushadi. Men uzoq va qiyin safarga chiqmoqchiman, uning favqulodda holatlari butun chidamimni talab qiladi: men nafaqat boshqalarning ruhini ko'tarishim, balki ba'zan, ularniki so'nayotganda, o'zimnikini ham ushlab turishim kerak.

paras.en: This is the most favourable period for travelling in Russia. They fly quickly over the snow in their sledges; the motion is pleasant, and, in my opinion, far more agreeable than that of an English stagecoach. The cold is not excessive, if you are wrapped in furs—a dress which I have already adopted, for there is a great difference between walking the deck and remaining seated motionless for hours, when no exercise prevents the blood from actually freezing in your veins. I have no ambition to lose my life on the post-road between St. Petersburgh and Archangel.
paras.uz: Bu Rossiyada sayohat qilish uchun eng qulay davr. Ular chanalarida qor ustida tez uchib yurishadi; harakat yoqimli va, menimcha, ingliz pochta aravasinikidan ancha maroqli. Agar mo'ynaga o'ralsang, sovuq haddan tashqari emas — men allaqachon shunday kiyimni qabul qildim, chunki palubada yurish bilan soatlab qimirlamay o'tirish o'rtasida katta farq bor, unda hech qanday harakat qonning tomirlaringda chindan muzlab qolishiga to'sqinlik qilmaydi. Sankt-Peterburg va Arxangelsk o'rtasidagi pochta yo'lida jonimni yo'qotish istagim yo'q.

paras.en: I shall depart for the latter town in a fortnight or three weeks; and my intention is to hire a ship there, which can easily be done by paying the insurance for the owner, and to engage as many sailors as I think necessary among those who are accustomed to the whale-fishing. I do not intend to sail until the month of June; and when shall I return? Ah, dear sister, how can I answer this question? If I succeed, many, many months, perhaps years, will pass before you and I may meet. If I fail, you will see me again soon, or never.
paras.uz: Ikki-uch haftadan keyin Arxangelskka jo'nayman; niyatim u yerda kema yollash — buni egasi uchun sug'urta to'lab, osongina qilish mumkin — va kit ovlashga odatlanganlar orasidan kerak deb hisoblaganimcha matros yollash. Iyungacha suzishni niyat qilmayman; qachon qaytaman esa? Oh, aziz singlim, bu savolga qanday javob beray? Agar muvaffaqiyat qozonsam, sen bilan uchrashgunimizcha ko'p, ko'p oylar, balki yillar o'tadi. Agar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrasam, meni tez orada ko'rasan yoki hech qachon ko'rmaysan.

paras.en: Farewell, my dear, excellent Margaret. Heaven shower down blessings on you, and save me, that I may again and again testify my gratitude for all your love and kindness.
paras.uz: Xayr, mening aziz, ajoyib Margaretim. Osmon senga barakalar yog'dirsin va meni asrasin, toki butun mehring va mehribonliging uchun minnatdorligimni qayta-qayta izhor eta olay.

paras.en: Your affectionate brother,
paras.uz: Seni sevuvchi akang,

paras.en: R. Walton
paras.uz: R. Uolton

paras.en: To Mrs. Saville, England.
paras.uz: Angliya, Saville xonimga.

paras.en: Archangel, 28th March, 17—.
paras.uz: Arxangelsk, 28-mart, 17—.

paras.en: How slowly the time passes here, encompassed as I am by frost and snow! Yet a second step is taken towards my enterprise. I have hired a vessel and am occupied in collecting my sailors; those whom I have already engaged appear to be men on whom I can depend and are certainly possessed of dauntless courage.
paras.uz: Ayoz va qor qurshovida bu yerda vaqt qanchalik sekin o'tadi! Shunga qaramay, maqsadim sari ikkinchi qadam tashlandi. Kema yolladim va matroslarimni to'plash bilan bandman; allaqachon yollaganlarim ishonsa bo'ladigan odamlarga o'xshaydi va, shubhasiz, ularda qo'rqmas jasorat bor.

paras.en: But I have one want which I have never yet been able to satisfy, and the absence of the object of which I now feel as a most severe evil, I have no friend, Margaret: when I am glowing with the enthusiasm of success, there will be none to participate my joy; if I am assailed by disappointment, no one will endeavour to sustain me in dejection. I shall commit my thoughts to paper, it is true; but that is a poor medium for the communication of feeling. I desire the company of a man who could sympathise with me, whose eyes would reply to mine. You may deem me romantic, my dear sister, but I bitterly feel the want of a friend.
paras.uz: Lekin bir ehtiyojim borki, uni hali hech qachon qondira olmaganman va uning yo'qligini endi eng og'ir baloday his qilyapman: Margaret, mening do'stim yo'q. Muvaffaqiyat zavqidan yonib turganimda, quvonchimni baham ko'radigan hech kim bo'lmaydi; umidsizlik meni bossa, tushkunlikda menga suyanch bo'lishga hech kim urinmaydi. To'g'ri, fikrlarimni qog'ozga ishonaman; lekin bu tuyg'ularni yetkazish uchun bechora vosita. Menga hamdard bo'la oladigan, ko'zlari ko'zlarimga javob beradigan odamning hamrohligi kerak. Meni xayolparast deb o'ylashing mumkin, aziz singlim, lekin men do'st yo'qligini achchiq his qilyapman.

paras.en: I have no one near me, gentle yet courageous, possessed of a cultivated as well as of a capacious mind, whose tastes are like my own, to approve or amend my plans. How would such a friend repair the faults of your poor brother! I am too ardent in execution and too impatient of difficulties. But it is a still greater evil to me that I am self-educated: for the first fourteen years of my life I ran wild on a common and read nothing but our Uncle Thomas’ books of voyages. At that age I became acquainted with the celebrated poets of our own country; but it was only when it had ceased to be in my power to derive its most important benefits from such a conviction that I perceived the necessity of becoming acquainted with more languages than that of my native country.
paras.uz: Yonimda rejalarimni ma'qullaydigan yoki tuzatadigan, yumshoq, lekin jasur, ham madaniyatli, ham keng fikrli, didi menikiga o'xshash hech kim yo'q. Bunday do'st bechora akangning nuqsonlarini qanday tuzatardi! Men ishni bajarishda haddan tashqari qizg'inman va qiyinchiliklarga juda sabrsizman. Lekin men uchun bundan ham kattaroq yomonlik — o'zimcha o'qiganligim: umrimning dastlabki o'n to'rt yili davomida men yaylovda o'zboshimcha yugurib yurdim va Tomas amakimizning sayohatlar haqidagi kitoblaridan boshqa hech narsa o'qimadim. O'sha yoshda men o'z yurtimizning mashhur shoirlari bilan tanishdim; lekin ona tilimdan boshqa tillarni ham bilish zarurligini faqat bunday ishonchdan eng muhim foydalarni olish imkonim qolmaganda angladim.

paras.en: Now I am twenty-eight and am in reality more illiterate than many schoolboys of fifteen. It is true that I have thought more and that my daydreams are more extended and magnificent, but they want (as the painters call it) keeping; and I greatly need a friend who would have sense enough not to despise me as romantic, and affection enough for me to endeavour to regulate my mind.
paras.uz: Endi men yigirma sakkiz yoshdaman va aslida o'n besh yoshli ko'p maktab o'quvchilaridan ham savodsizroqman. To'g'ri, men ko'proq o'ylaganman va xayollarim kengroq va ulug'vorroq, lekin ularda (rassomlar aytganidek) mutanosiblik yetishmaydi; menga meni xayolparast deb mensimaslik uchun yetarli aqli va fikrlarimni tartibga solishga urinish uchun yetarli mehri bor do'st juda kerak.

paras.en: Well, these are useless complaints; I shall certainly find no friend on the wide ocean, nor even here in Archangel, among merchants and seamen. Yet some feelings, unallied to the dross of human nature, beat even in these rugged bosoms. My lieutenant, for instance, is a man of wonderful courage and enterprise; he is madly desirous of glory, or rather, to word my phrase more characteristically, of advancement in his profession. He is an Englishman, and in the midst of national and professional prejudices, unsoftened by cultivation, retains some of the noblest endowments of humanity. I first became acquainted with him on board a whale vessel; finding that he was unemployed in this city, I easily engaged him to assist in my enterprise.
paras.uz: Xo'sh, bular befoyda shikoyatlar; men keng okeanda, hatto bu yerda, Arxangelskda, savdogarlar va dengizchilar orasida ham do'st topmasligim aniq. Shunga qaramay, inson tabiatining g'ashlari bilan qo'shilmagan ba'zi tuyg'ular hatto bu qo'pol ko'kraklarda ham uradi. Masalan, mening leytenantim ajoyib jasorat va tashabbus egasi; u shon-shuhratga, yaxshiroq aytganda, o'z kasbida yuksalishga telbalarcha intiladi. U ingliz va madaniyat yumshatmagan milliy va kasbiy xurofotlar orasida insoniyatning eng olijanob fazilatlaridan ba'zilarini saqlab qolgan. U bilan birinchi marta kit ovlash kemasida tanishganman; uning bu shaharda ishsiz yurganini bilib, uni ishimga yordam berishga osongina yolladim.

paras.en: The master is a person of an excellent disposition and is remarkable in the ship for his gentleness and the mildness of his discipline. This circumstance, added to his well-known integrity and dauntless courage, made me very desirous to engage him. A youth passed in solitude, my best years spent under your gentle and feminine fosterage, has so refined the groundwork of my character that I cannot overcome an intense distaste to the usual brutality exercised on board ship: I have never believed it to be necessary, and when I heard of a mariner equally noted for his kindliness of heart and the respect and obedience paid to him by his crew, I felt myself peculiarly fortunate in being able to secure his services. I heard of him first in rather a romantic manner, from a lady who owes to him the happiness of her life.
paras.uz: Kema kapitani a'lo fe'l-atvorli odam va kemada yumshoqligi va intizomining muloyimligi bilan ajralib turadi. Bu holat, uning hammaga ma'lum halolligi va qo'rqmas jasoratiga qo'shilib, uni yollashni juda istashimga sabab bo'ldi. Yolg'izlikda o'tgan yoshlik, sening yumshoq va ayollarcha tarbiyang ostida o'tgan eng yaxshi yillarim xarakterimning asosini shunchalik nozik qilganki, kemada odatda qo'llaniladigan qo'pollikka nisbatan kuchli jirkanishni yengib o'tolmayman: men uni hech qachon zarur deb hisoblamaganman va yuragining mehribonligi hamda ekipaji unga ko'rsatadigan hurmat va itoat bilan bir xilda mashhur dengizchi haqida eshitganimda, uning xizmatini qo'lga kirita olganimdan o'zimni alohida omadli his qildim. Men u haqda birinchi marta ancha romantik tarzda, hayotidagi baxti uchun undan qarzdor bo'lgan bir xonimdan eshitdim.

paras.en: This, briefly, is his story. Some years ago he loved a young Russian lady of moderate fortune, and having amassed a considerable sum in prize-money, the father of the girl consented to the match. He saw his mistress once before the destined ceremony; but she was bathed in tears, and throwing herself at his feet, entreated him to spare her, confessing at the same time that she loved another, but that he was poor, and that her father would never consent to the union. My generous friend reassured the suppliant, and on being informed of the name of her lover, instantly abandoned his pursuit.
paras.uz: Qisqacha aytganda, uning hikoyasi shunday. Bir necha yil oldin u o'rtacha boylikka ega yosh rus xonimni sevib qolgan va sovrin pullaridan ancha katta summa to'plagach, qizning otasi nikohga rozi bo'lgan. U belgilangan marosimdan oldin sevgilisini bir marta ko'rgan; lekin qiz ko'z yoshlariga g'arq bo'lib, uning oyoqlariga yiqilgan va o'zini ayashini yolvorib so'ragan, shu bilan birga boshqa birovni sevishini, lekin u kambag'al ekanini va otasi bu nikohga hech qachon rozi bo'lmasligini tan olgan. Saxiy do'stim yolvorayotgan qizni tinchlantirgan va sevgilisining ismini bilgach, darhol o'z intilishidan voz kechgan.

paras.en: He had already bought a farm with his money, on which he had designed to pass the remainder of his life; but he bestowed the whole on his rival, together with the remains of his prize-money to purchase stock, and then himself solicited the young woman’s father to consent to her marriage with her lover. But the old man decidedly refused, thinking himself bound in honour to my friend, who, when he found the father inexorable, quitted his country, nor returned until he heard that his former mistress was married according to her inclinations. “What a noble fellow!” you will exclaim. He is so; but then he is wholly uneducated: he is as silent as a Turk, and a kind of ignorant carelessness attends him, which, while it renders his conduct the more astonishing, detracts from the interest and sympathy which otherwise he would command.
paras.uz: U pulini allaqachon umrining qolgan qismini o'tkazishni rejalashtirgan fermaga sarflagan edi; lekin u uni to'liq raqibiga, chorva sotib olish uchun sovrin pulining qolgan qismi bilan birga in'om qilgan, keyin o'zi yosh ayolning otasidan qizining sevgilisiga turmushga chiqishiga rozilik berishni iltimos qilgan. Lekin chol o'zini do'stimga nisbatan sharaf bilan bog'langan deb hisoblab, qat'iyan rad etgan; do'stim otaning murosasiz ekanini ko'rib, yurtini tark etgan va sobiq sevgilisi o'z xohishiga ko'ra turmushga chiqqanini eshitmaguncha qaytmagan. «Qanday olijanob odam!» deb xitob qilasan. U shunday; lekin u butunlay o'qimagan: turkdek kamgap va unda qandaydir nodon beparvolik bor, bu uning xatti-harakatini yanada hayratlanarli qilsa ham, aks holda u uyg'otishi mumkin bo'lgan qiziqish va hamdardlikni kamaytiradi.

paras.en: Yet do not suppose, because I complain a little or because I can conceive a consolation for my toils which I may never know, that I am wavering in my resolutions. Those are as fixed as fate, and my voyage is only now delayed until the weather shall permit my embarkation. The winter has been dreadfully severe, but the spring promises well, and it is considered as a remarkably early season, so that perhaps I may sail sooner than I expected. I shall do nothing rashly: you know me sufficiently to confide in my prudence and considerateness whenever the safety of others is committed to my care.
paras.uz: Lekin biroz shikoyat qilayotganim yoki mehnatlarim uchun hech qachon bilmasligim mumkin bo'lgan tasallini tasavvur qila olganim uchun qarorlarimda ikkilanyapman deb o'ylama. Ular taqdirdek qat'iy va safarim faqat havo jo'nashimga imkon berguncha kechiktirilgan. Qish dahshatli darajada qattiq bo'ldi, lekin bahor yaxshi va'da beryapti, uni ajoyib darajada erta mavsum deb hisoblashmoqda, shuning uchun balki kutganimdan tezroq suzarman. Hech narsani shoshqaloqlik bilan qilmayman: boshqalarning xavfsizligi menga ishonib topshirilganda ehtiyotkorligim va mulohazakorligimga ishonish uchun meni yetarlicha bilasan.

paras.en: I cannot describe to you my sensations on the near prospect of my undertaking. It is impossible to communicate to you a conception of the trembling sensation, half pleasurable and half fearful, with which I am preparing to depart. I am going to unexplored regions, to “the land of mist and snow,” but I shall kill no albatross; therefore do not be alarmed for my safety or if I should come back to you as worn and woeful as the “Ancient Mariner.” You will smile at my allusion, but I will disclose a secret. I have often attributed my attachment to, my passionate enthusiasm for, the dangerous mysteries of ocean to that production of the most imaginative of modern poets. There is something at work in my soul which I do not understand. I am practically industrious—painstaking, a workman to execute with perseverance and labour—but besides this there is a love for the marvellous, a belief in the marvellous, intertwined in all my projects, which hurries me out of the common pathways of men, even to the wild sea and unvisited regions I am about to explore.
paras.uz: Ishim yaqinlashib kelayotganidagi his-tuyg'ularimni senga ta'riflab berolmayman. Jo'nashga tayyorlanayotgan yarim yoqimli, yarim qo'rqinchli titroq tuyg'u haqida senga tasavvur berish mumkin emas. Men o'rganilmagan o'lkalarga, «tuman va qor yurtiga» ketyapman, lekin hech qanday albatrosni o'ldirmayman; shuning uchun xavfsizligim uchun xavotirlanma, yoki agar senga «Keksa dengizchi»dek ozib-to'zib, g'amgin bo'lib qaytsam ham. Ishoramdan jilmayasan, lekin senga bir sirni ochaman. Men okeanning xavfli sirlariga bog'liqligim, ehtirosli ishtiyoqimni ko'pincha zamonaviy shoirlarning eng xayolparastining o'sha asariga bog'laganman. Ruhimda men tushunmaydigan nimadir ishlayapti. Men amaliy jihatdan tirishqoqman — sinchkov, qat'iyat va mehnat bilan ishni bajaradigan ishchi — lekin bundan tashqari barcha loyihalarimga chirmashib ketgan mo''jizaga muhabbat, mo''jizaga ishonch bor, u meni odamlarning oddiy yo'llaridan, hatto men kashf etmoqchi bo'lgan yovvoyi dengiz va hech kim bormagan o'lkalargacha shoshiltiradi.

paras.en: But to return to dearer considerations. Shall I meet you again, after having traversed immense seas, and returned by the most southern cape of Africa or America? I dare not expect such success, yet I cannot bear to look on the reverse of the picture. Continue for the present to write to me by every opportunity: I may receive your letters on some occasions when I need them most to support my spirits. I love you very tenderly. Remember me with affection, should you never hear from me again.
paras.uz: Lekin azizroq mulohazalarga qaytaylik. Ulkan dengizlarni kesib o'tib, Afrika yoki Amerikaning eng janubiy burnidan qaytgach, sen bilan yana uchrasharmikanman? Bunday muvaffaqiyatni kutishga jur'at etmayman, lekin manzaraning teskari tomoniga qarashga ham chiday olmayman. Hozircha har imkoniyatda menga yozib tur: ruhimni ko'tarish uchun ularga eng muhtoj bo'lganimda maktublaringni olishim mumkin. Seni juda nozik sevaman. Agar mendan boshqa hech qachon xabar eshitmasang, meni mehr bilan esla.

paras.en: Your affectionate brother, Robert Walton
paras.uz: Seni sevuvchi akang, Robert Uolton

paras.en: To Mrs. Saville, England.
paras.uz: Angliya, Saville xonimga.

paras.en: July 7th, 17—.
My dear Sister,
paras.uz: Aziz singlim,

paras.en: I write a few lines in haste to say that I am safe—and well advanced on my voyage. This letter will reach England by a merchantman now on its homeward voyage from Archangel; more fortunate than I, who may not see my native land, perhaps, for many years. I am, however, in good spirits: my men are bold and apparently firm of purpose, nor do the floating sheets of ice that continually pass us, indicating the dangers of the region towards which we are advancing, appear to dismay them. We have already reached a very high latitude; but it is the height of summer, and although not so warm as in England, the southern gales, which blow us speedily towards those shores which I so ardently desire to attain, breathe a degree of renovating warmth which I had not expected.
paras.uz: Sog'-salomat ekanimni va safarimda ancha oldinga siljiganimni aytish uchun shoshilib bir necha satr yozyapman. Bu maktub Angliyaga hozir Arxangelskdan uyiga qaytayotgan savdo kemasi orqali yetib boradi; u mendan omadliroq — men ona yurtimni, balki, ko'p yillar ko'rmasligim mumkin. Biroq kayfiyatim yaxshi: odamlarim dadil va aftidan maqsadida qat'iy, doimo yonimizdan o'tib turgan, biz borayotgan o'lkaning xavflaridan darak beruvchi suzib yuruvchi muz qatlamlari ham ularni qo'rqitmayotganga o'xshaydi. Biz allaqachon juda shimoliy kenglikka yetib keldik; lekin yozning qoq o'rtasi va Angliyadagidek iliq bo'lmasa ham, meni men shunchalik intilayotgan qirg'oqlar tomon tez haydayotgan janubiy shamollar men kutmagan darajada jonlantiruvchi iliqlik bilan esadi.

paras.en: No incidents have hitherto befallen us that would make a figure in a letter. One or two stiff gales and the springing of a leak are accidents which experienced navigators scarcely remember to record, and I shall be well content if nothing worse happen to us during our voyage.
paras.uz: Hozirgacha boshimizdan maktubda tilga olishga arziydigan hech qanday voqea o'tmadi. Bir-ikkita kuchli bo'ron va kemaning suv o'tkazib qo'yishi tajribali dengizchilar qayd etishni ham zo'rg'a eslaydigan hodisalar va agar safarimiz davomida bundan yomonroq narsa bo'lmasa, juda mamnun bo'laman.

paras.en: Adieu, my dear Margaret. Be assured that for my own sake, as well as yours, I will not rashly encounter danger. I will be cool, persevering, and prudent.
paras.uz: Xayr, aziz Margaret. Ishonchim komil bo'lsinki, o'zim uchun ham, sen uchun ham xavfga shoshqaloqlik bilan duch kelmayman. Men sovuqqon, qat'iyatli va ehtiyotkor bo'laman.

paras.en: But success shall crown my endeavours. Wherefore not? Thus far I have gone, tracing a secure way over the pathless seas, the very stars themselves being witnesses and testimonies of my triumph. Why not still proceed over the untamed yet obedient element? What can stop the determined heart and resolved will of man?
paras.uz: Lekin muvaffaqiyat harakatlarimga toj bo'ladi. Nega bo'lmasin? Shu paytgacha men yo'lsiz dengizlar bo'ylab xavfsiz yo'l chizib keldim, yulduzlarning o'zi g'alabamning guvohi va dalili. Nega hali yovvoyi, lekin itoatkor unsur bo'ylab davom etmaslik kerak? Insonning qat'iy yuragi va qaror topgan irodasini nima to'xtata oladi?

paras.en: My swelling heart involuntarily pours itself out thus. But I must finish. Heaven bless my beloved sister!
paras.uz: To'lib-toshgan yuragim beixtiyor shunday to'kiladi. Lekin tugatishim kerak. Osmon sevikli singlimni asrasin!

paras.en: R.W.
paras.uz: R.U.

paras.en: To Mrs. Saville, England.
paras.uz: Angliya, Saville xonimga.

paras.en: August 5th, 17—.
paras.uz: 5-avgust, 17—.

paras.en: So strange an accident has happened to us that I cannot forbear recording it, although it is very probable that you will see me before these papers can come into your possession.
paras.uz: Boshimizga shunchalik g'alati hodisa tushdiki, garchi bu qog'ozlar qo'lingga tegishidan oldin meni ko'rishing ehtimoli katta bo'lsa ham, uni yozib qo'ymasdan turolmayman.

paras.en: Last Monday (July 31st) we were nearly surrounded by ice, which closed in the ship on all sides, scarcely leaving her the sea-room in which she floated. Our situation was somewhat dangerous, especially as we were compassed round by a very thick fog. We accordingly lay to, hoping that some change would take place in the atmosphere and weather.
paras.uz: O'tgan dushanba kuni (31-iyul) bizni muz deyarli o'rab oldi, u kemani har tomondan qisib, suzib turishi uchun zo'rg'a joy qoldirdi. Ahvolimiz biroz xavfli edi, ayniqsa atrofimizni juda quyuq tuman qoplagan edi. Shuning uchun havo va ob-havoda qandaydir o'zgarish bo'lar degan umidda to'xtab turdik.

paras.en: About two o’clock the mist cleared away, and we beheld, stretched out in every direction, vast and irregular plains of ice, which seemed to have no end. Some of my comrades groaned, and my own mind began to grow watchful with anxious thoughts, when a strange sight suddenly attracted our attention and diverted our solicitude from our own situation. We perceived a low carriage, fixed on a sledge and drawn by dogs, pass on towards the north, at the distance of half a mile; a being which had the shape of a man, but apparently of gigantic stature, sat in the sledge and guided the dogs. We watched the rapid progress of the traveller with our telescopes until he was lost among the distant inequalities of the ice.
paras.uz: Soat ikkilarda tuman tarqaldi va har tomonga cho'zilgan, oxiri yo'qdek tuyulgan ulkan, notekis muz tekisliklarini ko'rdik. Hamrohlarimdan ba'zilari ingrashdi, mening ham xayolimni xavotirli fikrlar band eta boshladi, shu payt birdan g'alati manzara diqqatimizni tortdi va tashvishimizni o'z ahvolimizdan chalg'itdi. Yarim mil narida chanaga o'rnatilgan, itlar tortib borayotgan past arava shimolga qarab o'tib borayotganini ko'rdik; chanada inson qiyofasidagi, lekin aftidan ulkan bo'yli mavjudot o'tirib, itlarni boshqarardi. Sayyohning tez borishini u muzning uzoqdagi notekisliklari orasida ko'zdan g'oyib bo'lguncha durbinlarimiz bilan kuzatdik.

paras.en: This appearance excited our unqualified wonder. We were, as we believed, many hundred miles from any land; but this apparition seemed to denote that it was not, in reality, so distant as we had supposed. Shut in, however, by ice, it was impossible to follow his track, which we had observed with the greatest attention.
paras.uz: Bu ko'rinish bizni benihoya hayratga soldi. Biz, ishonishimizcha, har qanday quruqlikdan yuzlab mil uzoqda edik; lekin bu sharpa aslida quruqlik biz taxmin qilganchalik uzoq emasligini bildirayotgandek edi. Biroq muz qamalida qolgan holda biz katta diqqat bilan kuzatgan uning izidan borishning iloji yo'q edi.

paras.en: About two hours after this occurrence we heard the ground sea, and before night the ice broke and freed our ship. We, however, lay to until the morning, fearing to encounter in the dark those large loose masses which float about after the breaking up of the ice. I profited of this time to rest for a few hours.
paras.uz: Bu hodisadan taxminan ikki soat o'tgach, dengiz to'lqinining shovqinini eshitdik va kech tushmasdan muz yorilib, kemamizni ozod qildi. Biroq muz yorilgandan keyin suzib yuradigan o'sha katta bo'shashgan bo'laklarga qorong'ida duch kelishdan qo'rqib, tonggacha to'xtab turdik. Men bu vaqtdan foydalanib, bir necha soat dam oldim.

paras.en: In the morning, however, as soon as it was light, I went upon deck and found all the sailors busy on one side of the vessel, apparently talking to someone in the sea. It was, in fact, a sledge, like that we had seen before, which had drifted towards us in the night on a large fragment of ice. Only one dog remained alive; but there was a human being within it whom the sailors were persuading to enter the vessel. He was not, as the other traveller seemed to be, a savage inhabitant of some undiscovered island, but a European. When I appeared on deck the master said, “Here is our captain, and he will not allow you to perish on the open sea.”
paras.uz: Biroq ertalab tong yorishishi bilanoq palubaga chiqdim va barcha matroslar kemaning bir tomonida band bo'lib, aftidan dengizdagi kimdir bilan gaplashayotganini ko'rdim. Bu aslida biz oldin ko'rganimizga o'xshash chana edi, u kechasi katta muz parchasida biz tomonga suzib kelgan edi. Faqat bitta it tirik qolgan edi; lekin uning ichida bir inson bor edi va matroslar uni kemaga chiqishga ko'ndirishayotgan edi. U, boshqa sayyoh ko'ringanidek, qandaydir kashf etilmagan orolning yovvoyi aholisi emas, yevropalik edi. Men palubada paydo bo'lganimda kapitan dedi: «Mana bizning boshlig'imiz, u sizning ochiq dengizda halok bo'lishingizga yo'l qo'ymaydi.»

paras.en: On perceiving me, the stranger addressed me in English, although with a foreign accent. “Before I come on board your vessel,” said he, “will you have the kindness to inform me whither you are bound?”
paras.uz: Meni ko'rib, notanish menga ingliz tilida, garchi chet el talaffuzi bilan bo'lsa ham, murojaat qildi. «Kemangizga chiqishimdan oldin, — dedi u, — qayerga ketayotganingizni aytib berishga iltifot qilasizmi?»

paras.en: You may conceive my astonishment on hearing such a question addressed to me from a man on the brink of destruction and to whom I should have supposed that my vessel would have been a resource which he would not have exchanged for the most precious wealth the earth can afford. I replied, however, that we were on a voyage of discovery towards the northern pole.
paras.uz: Halokat yoqasida turgan va men o'ylaganimcha kemam yer yuzi bera oladigan eng qimmatbaho boylikka ham almashtirmaydigan najot bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan odamdan bunday savolni eshitib, qanchalik hayratlanganimni tasavvur qilishing mumkin. Biroq men shimoliy qutb tomon kashfiyot safarida ekanimizni aytdim.

paras.en: Upon hearing this he appeared satisfied and consented to come on board. Good God! Margaret, if you had seen the man who thus capitulated for his safety, your surprise would have been boundless. His limbs were nearly frozen, and his body dreadfully emaciated by fatigue and suffering. I never saw a man in so wretched a condition. We attempted to carry him into the cabin, but as soon as he had quitted the fresh air he fainted. We accordingly brought him back to the deck and restored him to animation by rubbing him with brandy and forcing him to swallow a small quantity. As soon as he showed signs of life we wrapped him up in blankets and placed him near the chimney of the kitchen stove. By slow degrees he recovered and ate a little soup, which restored him wonderfully.
paras.uz: Buni eshitib, u qoniqqandek bo'ldi va kemaga chiqishga rozi bo'ldi. Yaxshi Xudo! Margaret, agar o'z xavfsizligi uchun shunday shart qo'ygan odamni ko'rganingda, hayratingning cheki bo'lmasdi. Uning a'zolari deyarli muzlab qolgan, tanasi charchoq va azobdan dahshatli darajada ozib ketgan edi. Men hech qachon bunchalik ayanchli ahvoldagi odamni ko'rmaganman. Biz uni kayutaga olib kirmoqchi bo'ldik, lekin toza havodan chiqishi bilanoq hushidan ketdi. Shuning uchun uni yana palubaga olib chiqib, konyak bilan ishqalab va oz miqdorda yutishga majbur qilib, o'ziga keltirdik. U tiriklik alomatlarini ko'rsatishi bilanoq uni adyollarga o'rab, oshxona pechining mo'risi yoniga yotqizdik. Asta-sekin u o'ziga keldi va ozgina sho'rva ichdi, bu uni ajoyib tarzda tiklab qo'ydi.

paras.en: Two days passed in this manner before he was able to speak, and I often feared that his sufferings had deprived him of understanding. When he had in some measure recovered, I removed him to my own cabin and attended on him as much as my duty would permit. I never saw a more interesting creature: his eyes have generally an expression of wildness, and even madness, but there are moments when, if anyone performs an act of kindness towards him or does him any the most trifling service, his whole countenance is lighted up, as it were, with a beam of benevolence and sweetness that I never saw equalled. But he is generally melancholy and despairing, and sometimes he gnashes his teeth, as if impatient of the weight of woes that oppresses him.
paras.uz: U gapira olguncha shu tarzda ikki kun o'tdi va men ko'pincha azob-uqubatlari uni aqldan mahrum qilgan bo'lsa-ya deb qo'rqardim. U ma'lum darajada tuzalgach, uni o'z kayutamga ko'chirdim va burchim imkon bergancha unga qaradim. Men bundan qiziqroq mavjudotni hech qachon ko'rmaganman: uning ko'zlarida odatda yovvoyilik, hatto telbalik ifodasi bor, lekin shunday lahzalar bo'ladiki, agar kimdir unga yaxshilik qilsa yoki unga eng arzimas xizmat ko'rsatsa, uning butun chehrasi go'yo men hech qachon tengini ko'rmagan xayrixohlik va shirinlik nuri bilan yorishib ketadi. Lekin u odatda g'amgin va umidsiz, ba'zan esa go'yo uni ezayotgan qayg'ular og'irligiga chiday olmayotgandek tishlarini g'ijirlatadi.

paras.en: When my guest was a little recovered I had great trouble to keep off the men, who wished to ask him a thousand questions; but I would not allow him to be tormented by their idle curiosity, in a state of body and mind whose restoration evidently depended upon entire repose. Once, however, the lieutenant asked why he had come so far upon the ice in so strange a vehicle.
paras.uz: Mehmonim biroz tuzalgach, unga mingta savol bermoqchi bo'lgan odamlarni undan uzoq tutishda ancha qiynaldim; lekin tiklanishi ochiq-oydin to'liq orom-osoyishtalikka bog'liq bo'lgan tana va ruh holatida uni ularning bekorchi qiziquvchanligi bilan qiynashlariga yo'l qo'ymadim. Biroq bir marta leytenant undan nega muz ustida bunday g'alati ulovda shunchalik uzoqqa kelganini so'radi.

paras.en: His countenance instantly assumed an aspect of the deepest gloom, and he replied, “To seek one who fled from me.”
paras.uz: Uning chehrasi darhol eng chuqur g'am tusini oldi va u javob berdi: «Mendan qochgan birovni izlash uchun.»

paras.en: “And did the man whom you pursued travel in the same fashion?”
paras.uz: «Siz quvayotgan odam ham xuddi shunday yo'l bilan ketayotganmidi?»

paras.en: “Yes.”
paras.uz: «Ha.»

paras.en: “Then I fancy we have seen him, for the day before we picked you up we saw some dogs drawing a sledge, with a man in it, across the ice.”
paras.uz: «Unda, menimcha, biz uni ko'rganmiz, chunki sizni olib chiqishimizdan bir kun oldin muz ustida ichida bir odam bo'lgan chanani tortib ketayotgan itlarni ko'rgan edik.»

paras.en: This aroused the stranger’s attention, and he asked a multitude of questions concerning the route which the dæmon, as he called him, had pursued. Soon after, when he was alone with me, he said, “I have, doubtless, excited your curiosity, as well as that of these good people; but you are too considerate to make inquiries.”
paras.uz: Bu notanishning diqqatini tortdi va u o'zi iblis deb atagan mavjudot qaysi yo'ldan ketgani haqida ko'p savollar berdi. Ko'p o'tmay, men bilan yolg'iz qolganda, u dedi: «Men, shubhasiz, sizning ham, bu yaxshi odamlarning ham qiziqishingizni uyg'otdim; lekin siz so'rab-surishtirish uchun haddan tashqari odoblisiz.»

paras.en: “Certainly; it would indeed be very impertinent and inhuman in me to trouble you with any inquisitiveness of mine.”
paras.uz: «Albatta; sizni qandaydir qiziquvchanligim bilan bezovta qilish mendan juda beodoblik va g'ayriinsoniylik bo'lardi.»

paras.en: “And yet you rescued me from a strange and perilous situation; you have benevolently restored me to life.”
paras.uz: «Shunga qaramay siz meni g'alati va xavfli ahvoldan qutqardingiz; meni mehribonlik bilan hayotga qaytardingiz.»

paras.en: Soon after this he inquired if I thought that the breaking up of the ice had destroyed the other sledge. I replied that I could not answer with any degree of certainty, for the ice had not broken until near midnight, and the traveller might have arrived at a place of safety before that time; but of this I could not judge.
paras.uz: Bundan keyin ko'p o'tmay u muzning yorilishi boshqa chanani halok qilgan deb o'ylaymanmi, deb so'radi. Men biror aniqlik bilan javob bera olmasligimni aytdim, chunki muz yarim tunga yaqin yorilgan edi va sayyoh u vaqtgacha xavfsiz joyga yetib olgan bo'lishi mumkin edi; lekin buni hukm qila olmasdim.

paras.en: From this time a new spirit of life animated the decaying frame of the stranger. He manifested the greatest eagerness to be upon deck to watch for the sledge which had before appeared; but I have persuaded him to remain in the cabin, for he is far too weak to sustain the rawness of the atmosphere. I have promised that someone should watch for him and give him instant notice if any new object should appear in sight.
paras.uz: Shu paytdan boshlab notanishning so'nib borayotgan vujudini hayotning yangi ruhi jonlantirdi. U ilgari ko'ringan chanani kuzatish uchun palubada bo'lishga katta ishtiyoq ko'rsatdi; lekin men uni kayutada qolishga ko'ndirdim, chunki u havoning namligiga bardosh berish uchun juda zaif. Men kimdir uning o'rniga kuzatib turishini va agar yangi biror narsa ko'rinsa, unga darhol xabar berishini va'da qildim.

paras.en: Such is my journal of what relates to this strange occurrence up to the present day. The stranger has gradually improved in health but is very silent and appears uneasy when anyone except myself enters his cabin. Yet his manners are so conciliating and gentle that the sailors are all interested in him, although they have had very little communication with him. For my own part, I begin to love him as a brother, and his constant and deep grief fills me with sympathy and compassion. He must have been a noble creature in his better days, being even now in wreck so attractive and amiable.
paras.uz: Bu g'alati hodisaga oid bugungi kungacha bo'lgan kundaligim shunday. Notanishning sog'lig'i asta-sekin yaxshilandi, lekin u juda kamgap va mendan boshqa kimdir kayutasiga kirsa, bezovta bo'lganga o'xshaydi. Shunga qaramay uning muomalasi shunchalik yoqimli va muloyimki, u bilan juda kam muloqot qilgan bo'lsalar ham, matroslarning hammasi unga qiziqib qolgan. Men esa uni akamdek seva boshladim va uning doimiy va chuqur qayg'usi meni hamdardlik va rahm-shafqatga to'ldiradi. U yaxshi kunlarida olijanob mavjudot bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak, chunki hatto hozir, vayron holida ham, shunchalik jozibali va yoqimtoy.

paras.en: I said in one of my letters, my dear Margaret, that I should find no friend on the wide ocean; yet I have found a man who, before his spirit had been broken by misery, I should have been happy to have possessed as the brother of my heart.
paras.uz: Maktublarimdan birida, aziz Margaret, keng okeanda do'st topmayman, degan edim; lekin men shunday odamni topdimki, uning ruhi baxtsizlik bilan sindirilmasidan oldin uni yuragimning akasi sifatida qo'lga kiritsam, baxtli bo'lardim.

paras.en: I shall continue my journal concerning the stranger at intervals, should I have any fresh incidents to record.
paras.uz: Agar yozib qo'yadigan yangi voqealar bo'lsa, notanish haqidagi kundaligimni vaqti-vaqti bilan davom ettiraman.

paras.en: August 13th, 17—.
paras.uz: 13-avgust, 17—.

paras.en: My affection for my guest increases every day. He excites at once my admiration and my pity to an astonishing degree. How can I see so noble a creature destroyed by misery without feeling the most poignant grief? He is so gentle, yet so wise; his mind is so cultivated, and when he speaks, although his words are culled with the choicest art, yet they flow with rapidity and unparalleled eloquence.
paras.uz: Mehmonimga mehrim kundan-kunga ortib bormoqda. U bir vaqtning o'zida hayratimni ham, rahmimni ham hayratlanarli darajada uyg'otadi. Shunday olijanob mavjudotning baxtsizlik bilan vayron bo'layotganini eng achchiq qayg'u his qilmasdan qanday ko'ra olaman? U shunchalik muloyim, shu bilan birga shunchalik dono; aqli shunchalik madaniyatli va u gapirganda, so'zlari eng nafis san'at bilan tanlangan bo'lsa ham, ular tez va tengsiz notiqlik bilan oqadi.

paras.en: He is now much recovered from his illness and is continually on the deck, apparently watching for the sledge that preceded his own. Yet, although unhappy, he is not so utterly occupied by his own misery but that he interests himself deeply in the projects of others. He has frequently conversed with me on mine, which I have communicated to him without disguise. He entered attentively into all my arguments in favour of my eventual success and into every minute detail of the measures I had taken to secure it. I was easily led by the sympathy which he evinced to use the language of my heart, to give utterance to the burning ardour of my soul and to say, with all the fervour that warmed me, how gladly I would sacrifice my fortune, my existence, my every hope, to the furtherance of my enterprise.
paras.uz: U endi kasalligidan ancha tuzalgan va doimo palubada, aftidan o'zinikidan oldin ketgan chanani poylaydi. Shunga qaramay, baxtsiz bo'lsa ham, u o'z baxtsizligi bilan shunchalik to'liq band emaski, boshqalarning loyihalariga chuqur qiziqmasa. U men bilan ko'pincha mening loyihalarim haqida suhbatlashdi, men ularni unga yashirmasdan aytib berdim. U yakuniy muvaffaqiyatim foydasiga keltirgan barcha dalillarimga va uni ta'minlash uchun ko'rgan choralarimning har bir mayda tafsilotiga diqqat bilan e'tibor berdi. U ko'rsatgan hamdardlik meni yuragim tilida gapirishga, ruhimning yonayotgan ishtiyoqini izhor etishga va meni isitgan butun qizg'inlik bilan boyligimni, borlig'imni, har bir umidimni ishimning ravnaqi uchun qanchalik bajonidil qurbon qilishimni aytishga osongina undadi.

paras.en: One man’s life or death were but a small price to pay for the acquirement of the knowledge which I sought, for the dominion I should acquire and transmit over the elemental foes of our race. As I spoke, a dark gloom spread over my listener’s countenance. At first I perceived that he tried to suppress his emotion; he placed his hands before his eyes, and my voice quivered and failed me as I beheld tears trickle fast from between his fingers; a groan burst from his heaving breast. I paused; at length he spoke, in broken accents: “Unhappy man! Do you share my madness? Have you drunk also of the intoxicating draught? Hear me; let me reveal my tale, and you will dash the cup from your lips!”
paras.uz: Bir odamning hayoti yoki o'limi men izlagan bilimni qo'lga kiritish, zotimizning tabiiy dushmanlari ustidan qo'lga kiritadigan va meros qoldiradigan hukmronligim uchun to'lanadigan kichik narx edi. Men gapirarkanman, tinglovchimning chehrasini qorong'i g'am qopladi. Avvaliga u hayajonini bosishga urinayotganini payqadim; u qo'llarini ko'zlariga qo'ydi va barmoqlari orasidan ko'z yoshlari tez-tez oqayotganini ko'rib, ovozim titrab, uzilib qoldi; uning hansirayotgan ko'kragidan ingroq otilib chiqdi. Men to'xtadim; nihoyat u uzuq-yuluq ovozda gapirdi: «Baxtsiz odam! Siz ham mening telbaligimga sherikmisiz? Siz ham o'sha mast qiluvchi sharobdan ichganmisiz? Meni tinglang; hikoyamni ochishga ijozat bering va siz kosani labingizdan uloqtirib tashlaysiz!»

paras.en: Such words, you may imagine, strongly excited my curiosity; but the paroxysm of grief that had seized the stranger overcame his weakened powers, and many hours of repose and tranquil conversation were necessary to restore his composure.
paras.uz: Tasavvur qilishing mumkinki, bunday so'zlar qiziqishimni kuchli qo'zg'atdi; lekin notanishni qamrab olgan qayg'u xuruji uning zaiflashgan kuchlarini yengib qo'ydi va o'zini tutib olishi uchun ko'p soatlik dam olish va xotirjam suhbat kerak bo'ldi.

paras.en: Having conquered the violence of his feelings, he appeared to despise himself for being the slave of passion; and quelling the dark tyranny of despair, he led me again to converse concerning myself personally. He asked me the history of my earlier years. The tale was quickly told, but it awakened various trains of reflection. I spoke of my desire of finding a friend, of my thirst for a more intimate sympathy with a fellow mind than had ever fallen to my lot, and expressed my conviction that a man could boast of little happiness who did not enjoy this blessing.
paras.uz: His-tuyg'ularining shiddatini yenggach, u ehtirosning quli bo'lgani uchun o'zidan nafratlangandek bo'ldi; umidsizlikning qorong'i zulmini bostirib, meni yana o'zim haqimda suhbatga boshladi. U mendan oldingi yillarim tarixini so'radi. Hikoya tez aytib bo'lindi, lekin u turli fikrlar silsilasini uyg'otdi. Men do'st topish istagim, hech qachon nasib qilmagan darajada hamfikr bilan yaqinroq hamdardlikka tashnaligim haqida gapirdim va bu ne'matdan bahramand bo'lmagan odam baxti bilan kam maqtana olishiga ishonchimni bildirdim.

paras.en: “I agree with you,” replied the stranger; “we are unfashioned creatures, but half made up, if one wiser, better, dearer than ourselves—such a friend ought to be—do not lend his aid to perfectionate our weak and faulty natures. I once had a friend, the most noble of human creatures, and am entitled, therefore, to judge respecting friendship. You have hope, and the world before you, and have no cause for despair. But I—I have lost everything and cannot begin life anew.”
paras.uz: «Siz bilan roziman, — dedi notanish. — Agar bizdan donoroq, yaxshiroq, azizroq kimdir — do'st shunday bo'lishi kerak — zaif va nuqsonli tabiatimizni mukammallashtirishga yordam bermasa, biz shakllanmagan, yarim yaratilgan mavjudotlarmiz. Bir vaqtlar mening do'stim bor edi, insonlarning eng olijanobi, shuning uchun do'stlik haqida hukm chiqarishga haqqim bor. Sizda umid bor, dunyo oldingizda, umidsizlikka sabab yo'q. Lekin men — men hamma narsamni yo'qotdim va hayotni yangidan boshlay olmayman.»

paras.en: As he said this his countenance became expressive of a calm, settled grief that touched me to the heart. But he was silent and presently retired to his cabin.
paras.uz: Shuni aytarkan, uning chehrasida meni yuragimgacha ta'sirlantirgan sokin, qaror topgan qayg'u ifodasi paydo bo'ldi. Lekin u jim qoldi va ko'p o'tmay kayutasiga ketdi.

paras.en: Even broken in spirit as he is, no one can feel more deeply than he does the beauties of nature. The starry sky, the sea, and every sight afforded by these wonderful regions seem still to have the power of elevating his soul from earth. Such a man has a double existence: he may suffer misery and be overwhelmed by disappointments, yet when he has retired into himself, he will be like a celestial spirit that has a halo around him, within whose circle no grief or folly ventures.
paras.uz: Ruhi shunchalik singan bo'lsa ham, hech kim tabiat go'zalliklarini undan chuqurroq his qila olmaydi. Yulduzli osmon, dengiz va bu ajoyib o'lkalar beradigan har bir manzara hali ham uning ruhini yerdan ko'tarish qudratiga egadek. Bunday odamning ikki xil hayoti bor: u baxtsizlikdan azob chekishi va umidsizliklar ostida ezilishi mumkin, lekin o'ziga chekinganda, atrofida nur halqasi bor samoviy ruhga o'xshaydi, uning doirasiga hech qanday qayg'u yoki ahmoqlik kirishga jur'at eta olmaydi.

paras.en: Will you smile at the enthusiasm I express concerning this divine wanderer? You would not if you saw him. You have been tutored and refined by books and retirement from the world, and you are therefore somewhat fastidious; but this only renders you the more fit to appreciate the extraordinary merits of this wonderful man. Sometimes I have endeavoured to discover what quality it is which he possesses that elevates him so immeasurably above any other person I ever knew. I believe it to be an intuitive discernment, a quick but never-failing power of judgment, a penetration into the causes of things, unequalled for clearness and precision; add to this a facility of expression and a voice whose varied intonations are soul-subduing music.
paras.uz: Bu ilohiy sayyoh haqida bildirayotgan ishtiyoqimdan jilmayasanmi? Agar uni ko'rganingda, jilmaymasding. Sen kitoblar va dunyodan chekinish bilan tarbiyalangan va nafislashgansan, shuning uchun biroz injiqsan; lekin bu seni bu ajoyib odamning g'ayrioddiy fazilatlarini qadrlashga yanada loyiq qiladi. Ba'zan men uni men bilgan har qanday boshqa odamdan beqiyos yuqori ko'taradigan fazilat nima ekanini topishga urinardim. Menimcha, bu sezgi orqali anglash, tez, lekin hech qachon xato qilmaydigan hukm qudrati, ravshanlik va aniqlikda tengsiz bo'lgan narsalar sabablariga kirib borish qobiliyati; bunga ifoda yengilligini va turli ohanglari ruhni rom etuvchi musiqa bo'lgan ovozni qo'sh.

paras.en: August 19th, 17—.
paras.uz: 19-avgust, 17—.

paras.en: Yesterday the stranger said to me, “You may easily perceive, Captain Walton, that I have suffered great and unparalleled misfortunes. I had determined at one time that the memory of these evils should die with me, but you have won me to alter my determination. You seek for knowledge and wisdom, as I once did; and I ardently hope that the gratification of your wishes may not be a serpent to sting you, as mine has been. I do not know that the relation of my disasters will be useful to you; yet, when I reflect that you are pursuing the same course, exposing yourself to the same dangers which have rendered me what I am, I imagine that you may deduce an apt moral from my tale, one that may direct you if you succeed in your undertaking and console you in case of failure.
paras.uz: Kecha notanish menga dedi: «Kapitan Uolton, men buyuk va tengsiz baxtsizliklarni boshdan kechirganimni osongina payqashingiz mumkin. Bir vaqtlar men bu yovuzliklar xotirasi men bilan birga o'lishiga qaror qilgan edim, lekin siz meni qarorimni o'zgartirishga ko'ndirdingiz. Siz ham bir vaqtlar men kabi bilim va donolik izlaysiz; va men qizg'in umid qilamanki, istaklaringizning ro'yobga chiqishi meniki kabi sizni chaqadigan ilon bo'lmasin. Baxtsizliklarim hikoyasi sizga foydali bo'lishini bilmayman; lekin siz xuddi shu yo'ldan borayotganingizni, meni hozirgi holimga solgan xuddi shu xavflarga o'zingizni duchor qilayotganingizni o'ylasam, hikoyamdan o'rinli saboq chiqarishingiz mumkin, deb tasavvur qilaman — agar ishingizda muvaffaqiyat qozonsangiz sizga yo'l ko'rsatadigan va muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrasangiz sizga tasalli beradigan saboq.

paras.en: Prepare to hear of occurrences which are usually deemed marvellous. Were we among the tamer scenes of nature I might fear to encounter your unbelief, perhaps your ridicule; but many things will appear possible in these wild and mysterious regions which would provoke the laughter of those unacquainted with the ever-varied powers of nature; nor can I doubt but that my tale conveys in its series internal evidence of the truth of the events of which it is composed.”
paras.uz: Odatda mo''jizaviy deb hisoblanadigan voqealarni eshitishga tayyorlaning. Agar biz tabiatning yuvoshroq manzaralari orasida bo'lganimizda, sizning ishonchsizligingizga, balki masxarangizga duch kelishdan qo'rqishim mumkin edi; lekin bu yovvoyi va sirli o'lkalarda tabiatning doimo o'zgaruvchan kuchlari bilan tanish bo'lmaganlarning kulgisini qo'zg'atadigan ko'p narsalar mumkin bo'lib ko'rinadi; va hikoyam o'z ketma-ketligida u tashkil topgan voqealar haqiqatining ichki dalilini olib borishiga shubha qilmayman.»

paras.en: You may easily imagine that I was much gratified by the offered communication, yet I could not endure that he should renew his grief by a recital of his misfortunes. I felt the greatest eagerness to hear the promised narrative, partly from curiosity and partly from a strong desire to ameliorate his fate if it were in my power. I expressed these feelings in my answer.
paras.uz: Taklif qilingan hikoyadan juda mamnun bo'lganimni osongina tasavvur qilishing mumkin, lekin baxtsizliklarini hikoya qilib, qayg'usini yangilashiga chiday olmasdim. Va'da qilingan hikoyani eshitishga qisman qiziquvchanlikdan, qisman qo'limdan kelsa uning taqdirini yengillashtirish istagidan katta ishtiyoq his qildim. Javobimda bu tuyg'ularni bildirdim.

paras.en: “I thank you,” he replied, “for your sympathy, but it is useless; my fate is nearly fulfilled. I wait but for one event, and then I shall repose in peace. I understand your feeling,” continued he, perceiving that I wished to interrupt him; “but you are mistaken, my friend, if thus you will allow me to name you; nothing can alter my destiny; listen to my history, and you will perceive how irrevocably it is determined.”
paras.uz: «Hamdardligingiz uchun rahmat, — javob berdi u, — lekin u befoyda; taqdirim deyarli amalga oshdi. Men faqat bitta voqeani kutyapman, keyin tinchlikda orom olaman. Tuyg'ularingizni tushunaman, — davom etdi u, gapini bo'lmoqchi ekanimni payqab, — lekin adashasiz, do'stim, agar sizni shunday atashimga ruxsat bersangiz; hech narsa taqdirimni o'zgartira olmaydi; hikoyamni tinglang va u qanchalik qaytarib bo'lmas tarzda belgilanganini ko'rasiz.»

paras.en: He then told me that he would commence his narrative the next day when I should be at leisure. This promise drew from me the warmest thanks. I have resolved every night, when I am not imperatively occupied by my duties, to record, as nearly as possible in his own words, what he has related during the day. If I should be engaged, I will at least make notes. This manuscript will doubtless afford you the greatest pleasure; but to me, who know him, and who hear it from his own lips—with what interest and sympathy shall I read it in some future day! Even now, as I commence my task, his full-toned voice swells in my ears; his lustrous eyes dwell on me with all their melancholy sweetness; I see his thin hand raised in animation, while the lineaments of his face are irradiated by the soul within. Strange and harrowing must be his story, frightful the storm which embraced the gallant vessel on its course and wrecked it—thus!
paras.uz: Keyin u menga hikoyasini ertasi kuni men bo'sh bo'lganimda boshlashini aytdi. Bu va'da mendan eng iliq minnatdorlik chiqardi. Men har kecha, burchlarim bilan zarur band bo'lmaganimda, u kun davomida hikoya qilgan narsalarni iloji boricha o'z so'zlari bilan yozib qo'yishga qaror qildim. Agar band bo'lsam, hech bo'lmasa qaydlar qilaman. Bu qo'lyozma senga, shubhasiz, eng katta zavq bag'ishlaydi; lekin uni taniydigan va buni uning o'z og'zidan eshitayotgan men — kelajakda bir kun uni qanday qiziqish va hamdardlik bilan o'qiyman! Hatto hozir, vazifamni boshlarkanman, uning to'liq jarangdor ovozi quloqlarimda yangraydi; uning yaltiroq ko'zlari butun g'amgin shirinligi bilan menga tikiladi; uning jonlanib ko'tarilgan ozg'in qo'lini ko'raman, yuz chiziqlari esa ichidagi ruh bilan nurlanadi. Uning hikoyasi g'alati va dahshatli bo'lsa kerak, mardona kemani yo'lida quchoqlab, uni — shunday — halokatga uchratgan bo'ron qo'rqinchli bo'lsa kerak!

paras.en: I am by birth a Genevese, and my family is one of the most distinguished of that republic. My ancestors had been for many years counsellors and syndics, and my father had filled several public situations with honour and reputation. He was respected by all who knew him for his integrity and indefatigable attention to public business. He passed his younger days perpetually occupied by the affairs of his country; a variety of circumstances had prevented his marrying early, nor was it until the decline of life that he became a husband and the father of a family.
paras.uz: Men tug'ilishdan jenevalikman va oilam o'sha respublikaning eng nufuzli oilalaridan biri. Ajdodlarim ko'p yillar davomida maslahatchi va sindik bo'lib kelishgan, otam ham bir nechta davlat lavozimlarini sharaf va obro' bilan egallagan. Uni tanigan hamma uning halolligi va davlat ishlariga charchoq bilmas e'tibori uchun hurmat qilardi. U yoshlik yillarini doimo mamlakati ishlari bilan band holda o'tkazgan; turli holatlar unga erta uylanishga to'sqinlik qilgan va faqat umrining kech chog'idagina u er va oila otasi bo'lgan.

paras.en: As the circumstances of his marriage illustrate his character, I cannot refrain from relating them. One of his most intimate friends was a merchant who, from a flourishing state, fell, through numerous mischances, into poverty. This man, whose name was Beaufort, was of a proud and unbending disposition and could not bear to live in poverty and oblivion in the same country where he had formerly been distinguished for his rank and magnificence. Having paid his debts, therefore, in the most honourable manner, he retreated with his daughter to the town of Lucerne, where he lived unknown and in wretchedness. My father loved Beaufort with the truest friendship and was deeply grieved by his retreat in these unfortunate circumstances. He bitterly deplored the false pride which led his friend to a conduct so little worthy of the affection that united them. He lost no time in endeavouring to seek him out, with the hope of persuading him to begin the world again through his credit and assistance.
paras.uz: Uning nikohi holatlari xarakterini yaxshi ko'rsatgani uchun, ularni hikoya qilmasdan turolmayman. Uning eng yaqin do'stlaridan biri gullab-yashnagan holatdan ko'plab omadsizliklar tufayli qashshoqlikka tushib qolgan savdogar edi. Bofor ismli bu odam mag'rur va egilmas tabiatli bo'lib, ilgari mavqei va dabdabasi bilan ajralib turgan o'sha mamlakatda qashshoqlik va unutilishda yashashga chiday olmasdi. Shuning uchun qarzlarini eng sharafli tarzda to'lab, qizi bilan Lyutsern shahriga chekinib ketdi va u yerda hech kimga noma'lum holda, ayanchli hayot kechirdi. Otam Boforni eng chin do'stlik bilan sevardi va uning bu baxtsiz sharoitda chekinib ketganidan qattiq qayg'urdi. U do'stini ularni birlashtirgan mehrga shunchalik nomunosib xatti-harakatga olib kelgan soxta g'ururdan achchiq afsuslandi. U o'z obro'si va yordami bilan dunyoni yangidan boshlashga ko'ndirish umidida uni qidirib topishga vaqt yo'qotmadi.

paras.en: Beaufort had taken effectual measures to conceal himself, and it was ten months before my father discovered his abode. Overjoyed at this discovery, he hastened to the house, which was situated in a mean street near the Reuss. But when he entered, misery and despair alone welcomed him. Beaufort had saved but a very small sum of money from the wreck of his fortunes, but it was sufficient to provide him with sustenance for some months, and in the meantime he hoped to procure some respectable employment in a merchant’s house. The interval was, consequently, spent in inaction; his grief only became more deep and rankling when he had leisure for reflection, and at length it took so fast hold of his mind that at the end of three months he lay on a bed of sickness, incapable of any exertion.
paras.uz: Bofor yashirinish uchun samarali choralar ko'rgan edi va otam uning qarorgohini topguncha o'n oy o'tdi. Bu topilmadan behad xursand bo'lib, u Reyss daryosi yaqinidagi qashshoq ko'chada joylashgan uyga shoshildi. Lekin u kirganda uni faqat qashshoqlik va umidsizlik kutib oldi. Bofor boyligining vayronalaridan juda kichik pul summasini saqlab qolgan edi, lekin u bir necha oy ovqatlanishiga yetarli edi va bu orada u biror savdo uyida hurmatli ish topishga umid qilardi. Natijada bu vaqt harakatsizlikda o'tdi; o'ylash uchun bo'sh vaqti bo'lganda qayg'usi yanada chuqurlashib, achchiqlashdi va oxir-oqibat aqlini shunchalik mahkam egalladiki, uch oydan keyin u hech qanday harakatga qodir bo'lmay, kasal to'shagida yotib qoldi.

paras.en: His daughter attended him with the greatest tenderness, but she saw with despair that their little fund was rapidly decreasing and that there was no other prospect of support. But Caroline Beaufort possessed a mind of an uncommon mould, and her courage rose to support her in her adversity. She procured plain work; she plaited straw and by various means contrived to earn a pittance scarcely sufficient to support life.
paras.uz: Qizi unga eng katta mehr bilan qaradi, lekin ularning ozgina jamg'armasi tez kamayib borayotganini va boshqa hech qanday tirikchilik umidi yo'qligini umidsizlik bilan ko'rdi. Lekin Karolina Bofor g'ayrioddiy qolipdagi aql egasi edi va baxtsizlikda uni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun jasorati ko'tarildi. U oddiy tikuvchilik ishi topdi; somon to'qidi va turli yo'llar bilan hayotni saqlashga zo'rg'a yetadigan arzimas pul topishning uddasidan chiqdi.

paras.en: Several months passed in this manner. Her father grew worse; her time was more entirely occupied in attending him; her means of subsistence decreased; and in the tenth month her father died in her arms, leaving her an orphan and a beggar. This last blow overcame her, and she knelt by Beaufort’s coffin weeping bitterly, when my father entered the chamber. He came like a protecting spirit to the poor girl, who committed herself to his care; and after the interment of his friend he conducted her to Geneva and placed her under the protection of a relation. Two years after this event Caroline became his wife.
paras.uz: Shu tarzda bir necha oy o'tdi. Otasining ahvoli yomonlashdi; uning vaqti tobora ko'proq otasiga qarash bilan band bo'ldi; tirikchilik vositalari kamaydi; va o'ninchi oyda otasi uning quchog'ida jon berib, uni yetim va gado qilib qoldirdi. Bu so'nggi zarba uni yengib qo'ydi va u Boforning tobuti yonida tiz cho'kib, achchiq yig'layotganda xonaga otam kirdi. U o'zini uning qaramog'iga topshirgan bechora qizga himoyachi farishtadek keldi; do'stini dafn etgach, uni Jenevaga olib bordi va bir qarindoshining himoyasiga topshirdi. Bu voqeadan ikki yil o'tib Karolina uning xotini bo'ldi.

paras.en: There was a considerable difference between the ages of my parents, but this circumstance seemed to unite them only closer in bonds of devoted affection. There was a sense of justice in my father’s upright mind which rendered it necessary that he should approve highly to love strongly. Perhaps during former years he had suffered from the late-discovered unworthiness of one beloved and so was disposed to set a greater value on tried worth. There was a show of gratitude and worship in his attachment to my mother, differing wholly from the doting fondness of age, for it was inspired by reverence for her virtues and a desire to be the means of, in some degree, recompensing her for the sorrows she had endured, but which gave inexpressible grace to his behaviour to her. Everything was made to yield to her wishes and her convenience.
paras.uz: Ota-onam yoshi o'rtasida ancha farq bor edi, lekin bu holat ularni sadoqatli mehr rishtalari bilan yanada yaqinroq bog'laganga o'xshardi. Otamning to'g'ri aqlida adolat tuyg'usi bor ediki, u kuchli sevishi uchun yuksak qadrlashi zarur edi. Balki oldingi yillarda u sevgan kishining kech ochilgan nomunosibligidan azob chekkan va shuning uchun sinalgan qadrga ko'proq baho berishga moyil bo'lgandir. Uning onamga bog'liqligida minnatdorlik va sig'inish ko'rinishi bor edi, bu keksalikning bema'ni erkalashidan butunlay farq qilardi, chunki u onamning fazilatlariga ehtirom va u boshdan kechirgan qayg'ular uchun qaysidir darajada tovon to'lash vositasi bo'lish istagidan ilhomlangan edi va bu uning onamga bo'lgan muomalasiga ta'riflab bo'lmas nafislik berardi. Hamma narsa uning istaklari va qulayligiga bo'ysundirilardi.

paras.en: He strove to shelter her, as a fair exotic is sheltered by the gardener, from every rougher wind and to surround her with all that could tend to excite pleasurable emotion in her soft and benevolent mind. Her health, and even the tranquillity of her hitherto constant spirit, had been shaken by what she had gone through. During the two years that had elapsed previous to their marriage my father had gradually relinquished all his public functions; and immediately after their union they sought the pleasant climate of Italy, and the change of scene and interest attendant on a tour through that land of wonders, as a restorative for her weakened frame.
paras.uz: U uni bog'bon nozik ekzotik gulni himoya qilgandek har qanday qattiqroq shamoldan himoya qilishga va uni yumshoq va xayrixoh qalbida yoqimli his-tuyg'ular uyg'otishi mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsa bilan o'rashga intilardi. Uning sog'lig'i va hatto shu paytgacha barqaror bo'lgan ruhining xotirjamligi boshidan kechirganlari tufayli larzaga kelgan edi. Nikohlaridan oldingi ikki yil davomida otam asta-sekin barcha davlat vazifalaridan voz kechgan edi; va turmush qurganlaridan keyin darhol ular zaiflashgan vujudini tiklash uchun Italiyaning yoqimli iqlimini va o'sha mo''jizalar yurtiga sayohat bilan birga keladigan manzara va qiziqishlar o'zgarishini izlashdi.

paras.en: From Italy they visited Germany and France. I, their eldest child, was born at Naples, and as an infant accompanied them in their rambles. I remained for several years their only child. Much as they were attached to each other, they seemed to draw inexhaustible stores of affection from a very mine of love to bestow them upon me. My mother’s tender caresses and my father’s smile of benevolent pleasure while regarding me are my first recollections. I was their plaything and their idol, and something better—their child, the innocent and helpless creature bestowed on them by Heaven, whom to bring up to good, and whose future lot it was in their hands to direct to happiness or misery, according as they fulfilled their duties towards me. With this deep consciousness of what they owed towards the being to which they had given life, added to the active spirit of tenderness that animated both, it may be imagined that while during every hour of my infant life I received a lesson of patience, of charity, and of self-control, I was so guided by a silken cord that all seemed but one train of enjoyment to me.
paras.uz: Italiyadan ular Germaniya va Fransiyaga borishdi. Men, ularning to'ng'ich farzandi, Neapolda tug'ilganman va go'dakligimda ularning sayohatlarida hamroh bo'lganman. Bir necha yil men ularning yagona farzandi bo'lib qoldim. Bir-biriga qanchalik bog'liq bo'lmasinlar, ular menga in'om etish uchun mehrning tugamas zaxiralarini muhabbat konidan olib turgandek edilar. Onamning nozik erkalashlari va menga qarab turgan otamning mehribon zavq bilan jilmayishi — mening ilk xotiralarim. Men ularning o'yinchog'i va sanami edim, va bundan ham yaxshiroq narsa — ularning farzandi, Osmon ularga in'om etgan beg'ubor va ojiz mavjudot edim; uni yaxshilikka tarbiyalash va uning kelajakdagi qismatini menga nisbatan burchlarini qanday bajarishlariga qarab baxtga yoki baxtsizlikka yo'naltirish ularning qo'lida edi. Hayot bergan mavjudotga nimadan qarzdor ekanliklarini chuqur anglaganliklari va ikkalasini jonlantirgan faol mehr ruhi bilan, tasavvur qilish mumkinki, go'daklik hayotimning har soatida sabr, saxovat va o'zini tutish saboqlarini olgan bo'lsam ham, meni shunchalik ipak arqon bilan boshqarishganki, hammasi menga birgina lazzatlar silsilasi bo'lib tuyulardi.

paras.en: For a long time I was their only care. My mother had much desired to have a daughter, but I continued their single offspring. When I was about five years old, while making an excursion beyond the frontiers of Italy, they passed a week on the shores of the Lake of Como. Their benevolent disposition often made them enter the cottages of the poor. This, to my mother, was more than a duty; it was a necessity, a passion—remembering what she had suffered, and how she had been relieved—for her to act in her turn the guardian angel to the afflicted. During one of their walks a poor cot in the foldings of a vale attracted their notice as being singularly disconsolate, while the number of half-clothed children gathered about it spoke of penury in its worst shape.
paras.uz: Uzoq vaqt men ularning yagona tashvishi edim. Onam qiz farzand ko'rishni juda istardi, lekin men yagona farzandlari bo'lib qolaverdim. Men taxminan besh yoshda bo'lganimda, Italiya chegaralaridan tashqariga sayohat qilib, ular Komo ko'li sohilida bir hafta o'tkazishdi. Ularning xayrixoh tabiati ko'pincha ularni kambag'allarning kulbalariga kirishga undardi. Onam uchun bu burchdan ham ko'proq narsa edi; bu zarurat, ehtiros edi — o'zi qanday azob chekkanini va qanday yengillik topganini eslab — o'z navbatida g'amzadalarga qo'riqchi farishta bo'lish. Sayrlaridan birida vodiy burmalaridagi bir bechora kulba g'ayrioddiy g'amgin ko'rinishi bilan ularning diqqatini tortdi, uning atrofida to'plangan yarim yalang'och bolalarning ko'pligi esa qashshoqlikning eng og'ir ko'rinishidan dalolat berardi.

paras.en: One day, when my father had gone by himself to Milan, my mother, accompanied by me, visited this abode. She found a peasant and his wife, hard working, bent down by care and labour, distributing a scanty meal to five hungry babes. Among these there was one which attracted my mother far above all the rest. She appeared of a different stock. The four others were dark-eyed, hardy little vagrants; this child was thin and very fair. Her hair was the brightest living gold, and despite the poverty of her clothing, seemed to set a crown of distinction on her head.
paras.uz: Bir kuni otam yolg'iz o'zi Milanga ketganda, onam meni olib, bu uyga bordi. U yerda u mehnatkash, tashvish va mehnatdan bukilgan dehqon va uning xotinini beshta och go'dakka arzimas taomni tarqatayotgan holda topdi. Ular orasida onamni boshqalarning hammasidan ko'ra ko'proq o'ziga tortgan bitta qiz bor edi. U boshqa naslga mansubdek ko'rinardi. Qolgan to'rttasi qora ko'zli, chiniqqan kichkina sarsonlar edi; bu bola ozg'in va juda oq yuzli edi. Uning sochlari eng yorqin tirik oltin edi va kiyimining qashshoqligiga qaramay, boshiga go'yo alohidalik tojini kiygizgandek edi.

paras.en: Her brow was clear and ample, her blue eyes cloudless, and her lips and the moulding of her face so expressive of sensibility and sweetness that none could behold her without looking on her as of a distinct species, a being heaven-sent, and bearing a celestial stamp in all her features.
paras.uz: Uning peshonasi tiniq va keng, moviy ko'zlari bulutsiz, lablari va yuz tuzilishi shunchalik nozik his va shirinlik ifodasiga ega ediki, hech kim unga qarab, uni alohida zotga mansub, osmondan yuborilgan, barcha chehrasida samoviy muhr bo'lgan mavjudot deb bilmasdan turolmasdi.

paras.en: The peasant woman, perceiving that my mother fixed eyes of wonder and admiration on this lovely girl, eagerly communicated her history. She was not her child, but the daughter of a Milanese nobleman. Her mother was a German and had died on giving her birth. The infant had been placed with these good people to nurse: they were better off then. They had not been long married, and their eldest child was but just born.
