Azob o'tib ketdi, uning iztiroblari abadiy tugadi. Uning nozik vujudini chim qoplaydi va u og'riq bilmaydi. U endi rahm-shafqat ob'ekti bo'la olmaydi; biz uni uning baxtsiz qolganlari uchun saqlashimiz kerak.»

paras.en: Clerval spoke thus as we hurried through the streets; the words impressed themselves on my mind and I remembered them afterwards in solitude. But now, as soon as the horses arrived, I hurried into a cabriolet, and bade farewell to my friend.
paras.uz: Ko'chalardan shoshilib o'tarkanmiz, Klerval shunday gapirdi; so'zlar xotiramga o'rnashib qoldi va keyinroq yolg'izlikda ularni esladim. Lekin hozir otlar kelishi bilanoq men kabriolet aravaga shoshilib o'tirdim va do'stim bilan xayrlashdim.

paras.en: My journey was very melancholy. At first I wished to hurry on, for I longed to console and sympathise with my loved and sorrowing friends; but when I drew near my native town, I slackened my progress. I could hardly sustain the multitude of feelings that crowded into my mind. I passed through scenes familiar to my youth, but which I had not seen for nearly six years. How altered every thing might be during that time! One sudden and desolating change had taken place; but a thousand little circumstances might have by degrees worked other alterations, which, although they were done more tranquilly, might not be the less decisive. Fear overcame me; I dared no advance, dreading a thousand nameless evils that made me tremble, although I was unable to define them.
paras.uz: Safarim juda g'amgin o'tdi. Avvaliga shoshilishni istadim, chunki sevimli va qayg'uga botgan do'stlarimni yupatish va ularga hamdardlik bildirishni orzu qilardim; lekin ona shahrimga yaqinlashganimda, sur'atimni sekinlatdim. Aqlimga yopirilib kelgan ko'plab his-tuyg'ularga zo'rg'a bardosh berardim. Yoshligimdan tanish, lekin deyarli olti yildan beri ko'rmagan manzaralardan o'tdim. Shu vaqt ichida hamma narsa qanchalik o'zgargan bo'lishi mumkin! Bitta to'satdan va vayron qiluvchi o'zgarish yuz bergan edi; lekin mingta kichik holatlar asta-sekin boshqa o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirgan bo'lishi mumkin edi, ular sokinroq sodir bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, kamroq hal qiluvchi bo'lmasligi mumkin edi. Meni qo'rquv yengdi; men ta'riflay olmasam ham, meni titratgan mingta nomsiz yovuzlikdan qo'rqib, oldinga borishga jur'at etmadim.

paras.en: I remained two days at Lausanne, in this painful state of mind. I contemplated the lake: the waters were placid; all around was calm; and the snowy mountains, “the palaces of nature,” were not changed. By degrees the calm and heavenly scene restored me, and I continued my journey towards Geneva.
paras.uz: Men ruhning shu og'riqli holatida Lozannada ikki kun qoldim. Ko'lni tomosha qildim: suvlar osoyishta edi; atrofdagi hamma narsa sokin edi; qorli tog'lar — «tabiat saroylari» o'zgarmagan edi. Asta-sekin sokin va samoviy manzara meni tikladi va Jeneva tomon safarimni davom ettirdim.

paras.en: The road ran by the side of the lake, which became narrower as I approached my native town. I discovered more distinctly the black sides of Jura, and the bright summit of Mont Blanc. I wept like a child. “Dear mountains! my own beautiful lake! how do you welcome your wanderer? Your summits are clear; the sky and lake are blue and placid. Is this to prognosticate peace, or to mock at my unhappiness?”
paras.uz: Yo'l ko'l bo'yidan o'tardi, ona shahrimga yaqinlashgan sari ko'l torayib borardi. Men Yuraning qora yonbag'irlarini va Monblanning yorqin cho'qqisini aniqroq ko'rdim. Boladek yig'ladim. «Aziz tog'lar! mening go'zal ko'lim! sarson bo'lganingizni qanday kutib olasiz? Cho'qqilaringiz tiniq; osmon va ko'l moviy va sokin. Bu tinchlikdan darak berish uchunmi yoki baxtsizligim ustidan kulish uchunmi?»

paras.en: I fear, my friend, that I shall render myself tedious by dwelling on these preliminary circumstances; but they were days of comparative happiness, and I think of them with pleasure. My country, my beloved country! who but a native can tell the delight I took in again beholding thy streams, thy mountains, and, more than all, thy lovely lake!
paras.uz: Qo'rqamanki, do'stim, bu dastlabki holatlar ustida to'xtalib, sizni zeriktirib qo'yaman; lekin bular nisbatan baxtli kunlar edi va men ularni zavq bilan eslayman. Vatanim, sevimli vatanim! sening daryolaringni, tog'laringni va hammadan ham yoqimtoy ko'lingni yana ko'rganimdagi quvonchni vatandoshdan boshqa kim ayta oladi!

paras.en: Yet, as I drew nearer home, grief and fear again overcame me. Night also closed around; and when I could hardly see the dark mountains, I felt still more gloomily. The picture appeared a vast and dim scene of evil, and I foresaw obscurely that I was destined to become the most wretched of human beings. Alas! I prophesied truly, and failed only in one single circumstance, that in all the misery I imagined and dreaded, I did not conceive the hundredth part of the anguish I was destined to endure.
paras.uz: Lekin uyga yaqinlashgan sari qayg'u va qo'rquv meni yana yengdi. Tun ham cho'kdi; qorong'i tog'larni zo'rg'a ko'ra olganimda, yanada g'amginroq his qildim. Manzara ulkan va xira yovuzlik sahnasi bo'lib ko'rindi va men insonlarning eng baxtsizi bo'lishga mahkum ekanimni noaniq oldindan sezdim. Afsus! men to'g'ri bashorat qildim va faqat bitta holatda xato qildim: men tasavvur qilgan va qo'rqqan barcha baxtsizliklarda chidashga mahkum bo'lgan iztirobning yuzdan bir qismini ham tasavvur qilmagan edim.

paras.en: It was completely dark when I arrived in the environs of Geneva; the gates of the town were already shut; and I was obliged to pass the night at Secheron, a village at the distance of half a league from the city. The sky was serene; and, as I was unable to rest, I resolved to visit the spot where my poor William had been murdered. As I could not pass through the town, I was obliged to cross the lake in a boat to arrive at Plainpalais. During this short voyage I saw the lightning playing on the summit of Mont Blanc in the most beautiful figures. The storm appeared to approach rapidly, and, on landing, I ascended a low hill, that I might observe its progress. It advanced; the heavens were clouded, and I soon felt the rain coming slowly in large drops, but its violence quickly increased.
paras.uz: Jeneva atrofiga yetib kelganimda butunlay qorong'i edi; shahar darvozalari allaqachon yopilgan edi; va men tunni shahardan yarim liga masofadagi Seshron qishlog'ida o'tkazishga majbur bo'ldim. Osmon sokin edi; dam ololmaganim uchun bechora Uilyamim o'ldirilgan joyni ziyorat qilishga qaror qildim. Shahar orqali o'ta olmaganim uchun Plenpalega yetib borish uchun ko'lni qayiqda kesib o'tishga majbur bo'ldim. Bu qisqa safar davomida Monblan cho'qqisida chaqmoq eng go'zal shakllarda o'ynayotganini ko'rdim. Bo'ron tez yaqinlashayotganga o'xshardi va qirg'oqqa chiqqach, uning borishini kuzatish uchun past tepalikka ko'tarildim. U yaqinlashdi; osmonni bulut qopladi va tez orada yomg'ir katta tomchilar bo'lib sekin yog'a boshlaganini his qildim, lekin uning shiddati tez kuchaydi.

paras.en: I quitted my seat, and walked on, although the darkness and storm increased every minute, and the thunder burst with a terrific crash over my head. It was echoed from Salêve, the Juras, and the Alps of Savoy; vivid flashes of lightning dazzled my eyes, illuminating the lake, making it appear like a vast sheet of fire; then for an instant every thing seemed of a pitchy darkness, until the eye recovered itself from the preceding flash. The storm, as is often the case in Switzerland, appeared at once in various parts of the heavens. The most violent storm hung exactly north of the town, over the part of the lake which lies between the promontory of Belrive and the village of Copêt. Another storm enlightened Jura with faint flashes; and another darkened and sometimes disclosed the Môle, a peaked mountain to the east of the lake.
paras.uz: Joyimdan turdim va zulmat va bo'ron har daqiqada kuchayib, momaqaldiroq boshim ustida dahshatli gumburlab yorilayotgan bo'lsa ham, yurishda davom etdim. U Salev, Yura va Savoyya Alplaridan aks-sado berardi; yorqin chaqmoq chaqnashlari ko'zlarimni qamashtirib, ko'lni yoritar va uni ulkan olov qatlamidek ko'rsatardi; keyin ko'z oldingi chaqnashdan o'ziga kelguncha bir lahza hamma narsa qop-qorong'i bo'lib ko'rinardi. Bo'ron, Shveytsariyada tez-tez bo'lganidek, osmonning turli qismlarida birdaniga paydo bo'ldi. Eng shiddatli bo'ron aynan shaharning shimolida, ko'lning Belriv burni va Kope qishlog'i o'rtasidagi qismi ustida osilib turardi. Boshqa bo'ron Yurani xira chaqnashlar bilan yoritardi; yana biri esa ko'lning sharqidagi cho'qqili Mol tog'ini qorong'ilashtirib, ba'zan ochib qo'yardi.

paras.en: While I watched the tempest, so beautiful yet terrific, I wandered on with a hasty step. This noble war in the sky elevated my spirits; I clasped my hands, and exclaimed aloud, “William, dear angel! this is thy funeral, this thy dirge!” As I said these words, I perceived in the gloom a figure which stole from behind a clump of trees near me; I stood fixed, gazing intently: I could not be mistaken. A flash of lightning illuminated the object, and discovered its shape plainly to me; its gigantic stature, and the deformity of its aspect more hideous than belongs to humanity, instantly informed me that it was the wretch, the filthy dæmon, to whom I had given life. What did he there? Could he be (I shuddered at the conception) the murderer of my brother?
paras.uz: Shunchalik go'zal, shu bilan birga dahshatli bo'ronni kuzatarkanman, shoshilinch qadamlar bilan kezib yurdim. Osmondagi bu olijanob urush ruhimni ko'tardi; qo'llarimni qovushtirib, baland ovozda xitob qildim: «Uilyam, aziz farishta! bu sening dafn marosiming, bu sening marsiyang!» Bu so'zlarni aytarkanman, qorong'ilikda yonimdagi daraxtlar to'pi ortidan sirg'alib chiqqan bir qomatni payqadim; men qotib qolib, diqqat bilan tikildim: adashishim mumkin emas edi. Chaqmoq chaqnashi bu narsani yoritib, uning shaklini menga aniq ko'rsatdi; uning ulkan qomati va insoniyatga xos bo'lganidan ham xunukroq qiyofasining badbasharaligi darhol menga bu men hayot bergan o'sha bechora, o'sha iflos iblis ekanini bildirdi. U u yerda nima qilardi? U (bu fikrdan seskanib ketdim) ukamning qotili bo'lishi mumkinmi?

paras.en: No sooner did that idea cross my imagination, than I became convinced of its truth; my teeth chattered, and I was forced to lean against a tree for support. The figure passed me quickly, and I lost it in the gloom. Nothing in human shape could have destroyed the fair child. He was the murderer! I could not doubt it. The mere presence of the idea was an irresistible proof of the fact. I thought of pursuing the devil; but it would have been in vain, for another flash discovered him to me hanging among the rocks of the nearly perpendicular ascent of Mont Salêve, a hill that bounds Plainpalais on the south. He soon reached the summit, and disappeared.
paras.uz: Bu fikr xayolimdan o'tishi bilanoq uning haqiqat ekaniga amin bo'ldim; tishlarim taqilladi va suyanish uchun daraxtga tayanishga majbur bo'ldim. Qomat yonimdan tez o'tib ketdi va men uni qorong'ilikda yo'qotdim. Inson qiyofasidagi hech narsa o'sha go'zal bolani yo'q qila olmasdi. Qotil u edi! Bunga shubha qila olmasdim. Bu fikrning paydo bo'lishining o'zi faktning rad etib bo'lmas isboti edi. Men shaytonni ta'qib qilishni o'yladim; lekin bu behuda bo'lardi, chunki yana bir chaqnash uni menga Plenpaleni janubdan chegaralab turgan Salev tog'ining deyarli tik yonbag'ridagi qoyalar orasida osilib turgan holda ko'rsatdi. U tez orada cho'qqiga yetib, g'oyib bo'ldi.

paras.en: I remained motionless. The thunder ceased; but the rain still continued, and the scene was enveloped in an impenetrable darkness. I revolved in my mind the events which I had until now sought to forget: the whole train of my progress toward the creation; the appearance of the works of my own hands at my bedside; its departure. Two years had now nearly elapsed since the night on which he first received life; and was this his first crime? Alas! I had turned loose into the world a depraved wretch, whose delight was in carnage and misery; had he not murdered my brother?
paras.uz: Men qimirlamay qoldim. Momaqaldiroq to'xtadi; lekin yomg'ir hali ham davom etardi va manzarani o'tib bo'lmas zulmat qamrab oldi. Xayolimda shu paytgacha unutishga urinib kelgan voqealarni aylantirdim: yaratilish sari butun yo'lim; o'z qo'llarim ijodining to'shagim yonida paydo bo'lishi; uning ketishi. U birinchi marta hayot olgan tundan beri deyarli ikki yil o'tgan edi; va bu uning birinchi jinoyatimidi? Afsus! men dunyoga zavqi qirg'in va baxtsizlikda bo'lgan buzuq bechorani qo'yib yuborgan edim; u ukamni o'ldirmadimi?

paras.en: No one can conceive the anguish I suffered during the remainder of the night, which I spent, cold and wet, in the open air. But I did not feel the inconvenience of the weather; my imagination was busy in scenes of evil and despair. I considered the being whom I had cast among mankind, and endowed with the will and power to effect purposes of horror, such as the deed which he had now done, nearly in the light of my own vampire, my own spirit let loose from the grave, and forced to destroy all that was dear to me.
paras.uz: Tunning qolgan qismini sovuqda va ho'l bo'lib ochiq havoda o'tkazganimdagi iztirobimni hech kim tasavvur qila olmaydi. Lekin ob-havoning noqulayligini his qilmadim; tasavvurim yovuzlik va umidsizlik manzaralari bilan band edi. Men insoniyat orasiga tashlagan, hozir qilgan ishi kabi dahshatli maqsadlarni amalga oshirish irodasi va qudrati ato etilgan mavjudotni deyarli o'zimning vampirim, qabrdan qo'yib yuborilgan va menga aziz bo'lgan hamma narsani yo'q qilishga majbur bo'lgan o'z ruhim deb hisobladim.

paras.en: Day dawned; and I directed my steps towards the town. The gates were open, and I hastened to my father’s house. My first thought was to discover what I knew of the murderer, and cause instant pursuit to be made. But I paused when I reflected on the story that I had to tell. A being whom I myself had formed, and endued with life, had met me at midnight among the precipices of an inaccessible mountain. I remembered also the nervous fever with which I had been seized just at the time that I dated my creation, and which would give an air of delirium to a tale otherwise so utterly improbable. I well knew that if any other had communicated such a relation to me, I should have looked upon it as the ravings of insanity. Besides, the strange nature of the animal would elude all pursuit, even if I were so far credited as to persuade my relatives to commence it. And then of what use would be pursuit? Who could arrest a creature capable of scaling the overhanging sides of Mont Salêve? These reflections determined me, and I resolved to remain silent.
paras.uz: Tong otdi; va men qadamlarimni shahar tomon yo'naltirdim. Darvozalar ochiq edi va men otamning uyiga shoshildim. Birinchi fikrim qotil haqida bilganlarimni ochib, darhol ta'qib qilishni tashkil etish edi. Lekin aytib berishim kerak bo'lgan hikoya haqida o'ylab, to'xtadim. O'zim yaratgan va hayot ato etgan mavjudot yarim tunda borib bo'lmas tog' jarliklari orasida menga uchragan. Yaratilishimni hisoblagan aynan o'sha paytda meni chalg'itgan asab isitmasini ham esladim, u boshqa jihatdan mutlaqo aql bovar qilmas hikoyaga alahsirash tusini berardi. Agar boshqa birov menga shunday hikoyani aytib bersa, uni telbalik alahsirashi deb bilishimni yaxshi bilardim. Bundan tashqari, hatto qarindoshlarimni ta'qibni boshlashga ko'ndiradigan darajada menga ishonishsa ham, hayvonning g'alati tabiati har qanday ta'qibdan qochib qutulardi. Keyin ta'qibning nima foydasi bo'lardi? Salev tog'ining osilib turgan yonbag'irlariga chiqa oladigan maxluqni kim qo'lga ola oladi? Bu mulohazalar meni qat'iy qilib qo'ydi va men jim turishga qaror qildim.

paras.en: It was about five in the morning when I entered my father’s house. I told the servants not to disturb the family, and went into the library to attend their usual hour of rising.
paras.uz: Otamning uyiga kirganimda soat ertalab beshlar edi. Xizmatkorlarga oilani bezovta qilmaslikni aytdim va ular odatda turadigan vaqtni kutish uchun kutubxonaga kirdim.

paras.en: Six years had elapsed, passed in a dream but for one indelible trace, and I stood in the same place where I had last embraced my father before my departure for Ingolstadt. Beloved and venerable parent! He still remained to me. I gazed on the picture of my mother, which stood over the mantel-piece. It was an historical subject, painted at my father’s desire, and represented Caroline Beaufort in an agony of despair, kneeling by the coffin of her dead father. Her garb was rustic, and her cheek pale; but there was an air of dignity and beauty, that hardly permitted the sentiment of pity. Below this picture was a miniature of William; and my tears flowed when I looked upon it. While I was thus engaged, Ernest entered: he had heard me arrive, and hastened to welcome me: “Welcome, my dearest Victor,” said he. “Ah!
paras.uz: Bitta o'chmas izdan tashqari tushdek o'tgan olti yil o'tib ketgan edi va men Ingolshtadtga jo'nashimdan oldin otamni oxirgi marta quchoqlagan o'sha joyda turardim. Suyukli va muhtaram ota! U hali ham menga qolgan edi. Kamin ustida turgan onamning suratiga tikildim. Bu otamning xohishi bilan chizilgan tarixiy mavzudagi surat bo'lib, unda Karolina Bofor marhum otasining tobuti yonida umidsizlik iztirobida tiz cho'kib turgan holda tasvirlangan edi. Uning kiyimi qishloqcha, yonog'i rangpar edi; lekin unda rahm-shafqat tuyg'usiga zo'rg'a yo'l qo'yadigan viqor va go'zallik bor edi. Bu surat ostida Uilyamning miniatyurasi bor edi; unga qaraganimda ko'z yoshlarim oqdi. Shu bilan band bo'lib turganimda, Ernest kirdi: u kelganimni eshitib, meni kutib olishga shoshilgan edi: «Xush kelibsan, eng aziz Viktorim, — dedi u. — Oh!

paras.en: I wish you had come three months ago, and then you would have found us all joyous and delighted. You come to us now to share a misery which nothing can alleviate; yet your presence will, I hope, revive our father, who seems sinking under his misfortune; and your persuasions will induce poor Elizabeth to cease her vain and tormenting self-accusations.—Poor William! he was our darling and our pride!”
paras.uz: Qaniydi uch oy oldin kelganingda, shunda hammamizni quvnoq va xursand holda topgan bo'larding. Sen bizga hech narsa yengillata olmaydigan baxtsizlikni baham ko'rish uchun kelding; shunga qaramay umid qilamanki, sening borliging baxtsizligi ostida cho'kib borayotganga o'xshagan otamizni jonlantiradi; va sening ko'ndirishlaring bechora Elizabetni behuda va qiynovchi o'zini ayblashlarini to'xtatishga undaydi. — Bechora Uilyam! u bizning erkatoyimiz va g'ururimiz edi!»

paras.en: Tears, unrestrained, fell from my brother’s eyes; a sense of mortal agony crept over my frame. Before, I had only imagined the wretchedness of my desolated home; the reality came on me as a new, and a not less terrible, disaster. I tried to calm Ernest; I enquired more minutely concerning my father, and here I named my cousin.
paras.uz: Ukamning ko'zlaridan jilovsiz yoshlar to'kildi; vujudimni o'limtik iztirob tuyg'usi qamrab oldi. Ilgari men vayron bo'lgan uyimning baxtsizligini faqat tasavvur qilgan edim; haqiqat menga yangi va kamroq dahshatli bo'lmagan falokat sifatida tushdi. Men Ernestni tinchlantirishga urindim; otam haqida batafsilroq so'radim va shu yerda amakivachchamni tilga oldim.

paras.en: “She most of all,” said Ernest, “requires consolation; she accused herself of having caused the death of my brother, and that made her very wretched. But since the murderer has been discovered—”
paras.uz: «U hammadan ko'ra ko'proq tasalliga muhtoj, — dedi Ernest, — u o'zini ukamning o'limiga sabab bo'lganlikda aybladi va bu uni juda baxtsiz qildi. Lekin qotil topilganidan beri —»

paras.en: “The murderer discovered! Good God! how can that be? who could attempt to pursue him? It is impossible; one might as well try to overtake the winds, or confine a mountain-stream with a straw. I saw him too; he was free last night!”
paras.uz: «Qotil topildi! Yaxshi Xudo! bu qanday bo'lishi mumkin? kim uni ta'qib qilishga urinishi mumkin edi? Bu mumkin emas; shamollarni quvib yetishga yoki tog' soyini somon bilan to'sishga urinish mumkin. Men ham uni ko'rdim; u kecha kechasi ozod edi!»

paras.en: “I do not know what you mean,” replied my brother, in accents of wonder, “but to us the discovery we have made completes our misery. No one would believe it at first; and even now Elizabeth will not be convinced, notwithstanding all the evidence. Indeed, who would credit that Justine Moritz, who was so amiable, and fond of all the family, could suddenly become so capable of so frightful, so appalling a crime?”
paras.uz: «Nima demoqchi ekaningni bilmayman, — javob berdi ukam hayratli ohangda, — lekin biz uchun qilgan kashfiyotimiz baxtsizligimizni to'ldiradi. Dastlab hech kim bunga ishonmasdi; hatto hozir ham Elizabet barcha dalillarga qaramay ishonmayapti. Haqiqatan ham, shunchalik yoqimtoy va butun oilani yaxshi ko'radigan Jastin Morits birdan shunday qo'rqinchli, shunday dahshatli jinoyatga qodir bo'lishiga kim ishonadi?»

paras.en: “Justine Moritz! Poor, poor girl, is she the accused? But it is wrongfully; every one knows that; no one believes it, surely, Ernest?”
paras.uz: «Jastin Morits! Bechora, bechora qiz, ayblanuvchi u-mi? Lekin bu nohaq; buni hamma biladi; albatta hech kim bunga ishonmaydi-ku, Ernest?»

paras.en: “No one did at first; but several circumstances came out, that have almost forced conviction upon us; and her own behaviour has been so confused, as to add to the evidence of facts a weight that, I fear, leaves no hope for doubt. But she will be tried today, and you will then hear all.”
paras.uz: «Dastlab hech kim ishonmadi; lekin bir nechta holatlar ma'lum bo'ldi, ular bizni deyarli ishonishga majbur qildi; uning o'z xatti-harakati esa shunchalik sarosimali bo'ldiki, faktlar dalillariga qo'rqamanki, shubhaga umid qoldirmaydigan og'irlik qo'shdi. Lekin uni bugun sud qilishadi va o'shanda hammasini eshitasan.»

paras.en: He then related that, the morning on which the murder of poor William had been discovered, Justine had been taken ill, and confined to her bed for several days. During this interval, one of the servants, happening to examine the apparel she had worn on the night of the murder, had discovered in her pocket the picture of my mother, which had been judged to be the temptation of the murderer. The servant instantly showed it to one of the others, who, without saying a word to any of the family, went to a magistrate; and, upon their deposition, Justine was apprehended. On being charged with the fact, the poor girl confirmed the suspicion in a great measure by her extreme confusion of manner.
paras.uz: Keyin u bechora Uilyamning o'ldirilgani aniqlangan kuni ertalab Jastin kasal bo'lib qolganini va bir necha kun to'shakda yotganini aytib berdi. Bu orada xizmatkorlardan biri tasodifan uning qotillik kechasi kiygan kiyimini ko'zdan kechirib, cho'ntagidan onamning suratini topgan, u esa qotilning vasvasasi deb hisoblangan edi. Xizmatkor darhol uni boshqalardan biriga ko'rsatgan, u esa oilaga bir og'iz ham demasdan sudyaga borgan; va ularning ko'rsatmasi asosida Jastin hibsga olingan. Unga bu ayb qo'yilganda, bechora qiz o'zini nihoyatda sarosimali tutishi bilan gumonni katta darajada tasdiqlagan.

paras.en: This was a strange tale, but it did not shake my faith; and I replied earnestly, “You are all mistaken; I know the murderer. Justine, poor, good Justine, is innocent.”
paras.uz: Bu g'alati hikoya edi, lekin u ishonchimni silkitmadi; va men astoydil javob berdim: «Hammangiz adashyapsiz; men qotilni bilaman. Jastin, bechora, yaxshi Jastin aybsiz.»

paras.en: At that instant my father entered. I saw unhappiness deeply impressed on his countenance, but he endeavoured to welcome me cheerfully; and, after we had exchanged our mournful greeting, would have introduced some other topic than that of our disaster, had not Ernest exclaimed, “Good God, papa! Victor says that he knows who was the murderer of poor William.”
paras.uz: Shu lahzada otam kirdi. Men uning chehrasida chuqur o'rnashgan baxtsizlikni ko'rdim, lekin u meni quvnoq kutib olishga harakat qildi; va qayg'uli salomlashganimizdan keyin, agar Ernest «Yaxshi Xudo, dada! Viktor bechora Uilyamning qotili kim ekanini bilaman deyapti», deb xitob qilmaganida, fojiamizdan boshqa biror mavzuni boshlagan bo'lardi.

paras.en: “We do also, unfortunately,” replied my father, “for indeed I had rather have been for ever ignorant than have discovered so much depravity and ungratitude in one I valued so highly.”
paras.uz: «Afsuski, biz ham bilamiz, — javob berdi otam, — chunki haqiqatan ham men shunchalik qadrlagan odamda shunchalik buzuqlik va noshukurlik borligini bilib olgandan ko'ra abadiy bexabar qolganni afzal ko'rardim.»

paras.en: “My dear father, you are mistaken; Justine is innocent.”
paras.uz: «Aziz otam, siz adashyapsiz; Jastin aybsiz.»

paras.en: “If she is, God forbid that she should suffer as guilty. She is to be tried today, and I hope, I sincerely hope, that she will be acquitted.”
paras.uz: «Agar shunday bo'lsa, Xudo saqlasin, aybdor sifatida jabr ko'rmasin. Uni bugun sud qilishadi va umid qilaman, chin dildan umid qilamanki, u oqlanadi.»

paras.en: This speech calmed me. I was firmly convinced in my own mind that Justine, and indeed every human being, was guiltless of this murder. I had no fear, therefore, that any circumstantial evidence could be brought forward strong enough to convict her. My tale was not one to announce publicly; its astounding horror would be looked upon as madness by the vulgar. Did any one indeed exist, except I, the creator, who would believe, unless his senses convinced him, in the existence of the living monument of presumption and rash ignorance which I had let loose upon the world?
paras.uz: Bu gap meni tinchlantirdi. Men o'z ichimda Jastin, aslida har qanday inson bu qotillikda aybsiz ekaniga qat'iy amin edim. Shuning uchun uni aybdor deb topish uchun yetarlicha kuchli bilvosita dalil keltirilishidan qo'rqmadim. Mening hikoyam ko'pchilik oldida e'lon qilinadigan hikoya emas edi; uning hayratlanarli dahshati oddiy xalq tomonidan telbalik deb qaralardi. Haqiqatan ham, yaratuvchisi bo'lgan mendan boshqa, agar hissiyotlari uni ishontirmasa, men dunyoga qo'yib yuborgan takabburlik va shoshqaloq nodonlikning tirik yodgorligi borligiga ishonadigan biror kishi bormidi?

paras.en: We were soon joined by Elizabeth. Time had altered her since I last beheld her; it had endowed her with loveliness surpassing the beauty of her childish years. There was the same candour, the same vivacity, but it was allied to an expression more full of sensibility and intellect. She welcomed me with the greatest affection. “Your arrival, my dear cousin,” said she, “fills me with hope. You perhaps will find some means to justify my poor guiltless Justine. Alas! who is safe, if she be convicted of crime? I rely on her innocence as certainly as I do upon my own. Our misfortune is doubly hard to us; we have not only lost that lovely darling boy, but this poor girl, whom I sincerely love, is to be torn away by even a worse fate. If she is condemned, I never shall know joy more. But she will not, I am sure she will not; and then I shall be happy again, even after the sad death of my little William.”
paras.uz: Tez orada bizga Elizabet qo'shildi. Men uni oxirgi marta ko'rganimdan beri vaqt uni o'zgartirgan edi; u unga bolalik yillaridagi go'zallikdan ham ustun keladigan latofat bergan edi. Xuddi o'sha samimiylik, xuddi o'sha jonlilik bor edi, lekin u ko'proq nozik his va aqlga to'la ifoda bilan qo'shilgan edi. U meni eng katta mehr bilan kutib oldi. «Sening kelishing, aziz amakivachcham, — dedi u, — meni umidga to'ldiradi. Balki sen bechora aybsiz Jastinimni oqlashning biror yo'lini topasan. Afsus! agar u jinoyatda aybdor deb topilsa, kim xavfsiz? Men uning aybsizligiga o'zimnikidek aniq ishonaman. Baxtsizligimiz biz uchun ikki baravar og'ir; biz nafaqat o'sha yoqimtoy jonajon bolani yo'qotdik, balki men chin dildan sevadigan bu bechora qiz ham undan ham yomonroq taqdir bilan yulib olinmoqchi. Agar u hukm qilinsa, men boshqa hech qachon quvonch nimaligini bilmayman. Lekin hukm qilinmaydi, ishonchim komilki, hukm qilinmaydi; shunda men kichkina Uilyamimning qayg'uli o'limidan keyin ham yana baxtli bo'laman.»

paras.en: “She is innocent, my Elizabeth,” said I, “and that shall be proved; fear nothing, but let your spirits be cheered by the assurance of her acquittal.”
paras.uz: «U aybsiz, Elizabetim, — dedim men, — va bu isbotlanadi; hech narsadan qo'rqma, uning oqlanishiga ishonch bilan ruhing ko'tarilsin.»

paras.en: “How kind and generous you are! every one else believes in her guilt, and that made me wretched, for I knew that it was impossible: and to see every one else prejudiced in so deadly a manner rendered me hopeless and despairing.” She wept.
paras.uz: «Qanchalik mehribon va olijanobsan! boshqa hamma uning aybiga ishonadi va bu meni baxtsiz qildi, chunki bu mumkin emasligini bilardim: hammaning shunday halokatli tarzda xurofotga berilganini ko'rish meni umidsiz va noumid qildi.» U yig'ladi.

paras.en: “Dearest niece,” said my father, “dry your tears. If she is, as you believe, innocent, rely on the justice of our laws, and the activity with which I shall prevent the slightest shadow of partiality.”
paras.uz: «Eng aziz jiyanim, — dedi otam, — ko'z yoshlaringni art. Agar u, sen ishonganingdek, aybsiz bo'lsa, qonunlarimizning adolatiga va men tarafkashlikning eng kichik soyasiga ham yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun ko'rsatadigan g'ayratimga ishon.»

paras.en: We passed a few sad hours until eleven o’clock, when the trial was to commence. My father and the rest of the family being obliged to attend as witnesses, I accompanied them to the court. During the whole of this wretched mockery of justice I suffered living torture. It was to be decided whether the result of my curiosity and lawless devices would cause the death of two of my fellow beings: one a smiling babe full of innocence and joy, the other far more dreadfully murdered, with every aggravation of infamy that could make the murder memorable in horror. Justine also was a girl of merit and possessed qualities which promised to render her life happy; now all was to be obliterated in an ignominious grave, and I the cause! A thousand times rather would I have confessed myself guilty of the crime ascribed to Justine, but I was absent when it was committed, and such a declaration would have been considered as the ravings of a madman and would not have exculpated her who suffered through me.
paras.uz: Sud boshlanishi kerak bo'lgan soat o'n birgacha bir necha g'amgin soatni o'tkazdik. Otam va oilaning qolgan a'zolari guvoh sifatida qatnashishga majbur bo'lgani uchun, men ularga sudga hamroh bo'ldim. Adolatning bu ayanchli masxarabozligi davomida men tirik qiynoqni boshdan kechirdim. Qiziquvchanligim va qonunsiz uydirmalarimning natijasi ikki hamjinsimning o'limiga sabab bo'ladimi-yo'qmi, shu hal qilinishi kerak edi: biri beg'uborlik va quvonchga to'la jilmayib turgan go'dak, ikkinchisi esa qotillikni dahshatda unutilmas qila oladigan har qanday sharmandalik bilan og'irlashtirilgan, ancha dahshatliroq tarzda o'ldirilgan. Jastin ham fazilatli qiz edi va uning hayotini baxtli qilishni va'da qilgan xislatlarga ega edi; endi hammasi sharmandali qabrda o'chirib tashlanishi kerak edi, sababchisi esa men! Ming marta Jastinga nisbat berilgan jinoyatda o'zimni aybdor deb tan olgan bo'lardim, lekin u sodir etilganda men yo'q edim va bunday bayonot telbaning alahsirashi deb hisoblanib, men tufayli azob chekayotgan qizni oqlamagan bo'lardi.

paras.en: The appearance of Justine was calm. She was dressed in mourning, and her countenance, always engaging, was rendered, by the solemnity of her feelings, exquisitely beautiful. Yet she appeared confident in innocence and did not tremble, although gazed on and execrated by thousands, for all the kindness which her beauty might otherwise have excited was obliterated in the minds of the spectators by the imagination of the enormity she was supposed to have committed. She was tranquil, yet her tranquillity was evidently constrained; and as her confusion had before been adduced as a proof of her guilt, she worked up her mind to an appearance of courage. When she entered the court she threw her eyes round it and quickly discovered where we were seated. A tear seemed to dim her eye when she saw us, but she quickly recovered herself, and a look of sorrowful affection seemed to attest her utter guiltlessness.
paras.uz: Jastin xotirjam ko'rinardi. U motam kiyimida edi va doim yoqimli bo'lgan chehrasi his-tuyg'ularining tantanavorligi bilan nafis go'zal bo'lib ko'rinardi. Shunga qaramay u aybsizligiga ishongandek edi va minglab odamlar unga tikilib, la'natlayotgan bo'lsa ham titramasdi, chunki uning go'zalligi aks holda uyg'otishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday mehribonlik tomoshabinlarning ongida u sodir etgan deb taxmin qilingan dahshatli jinoyat tasavvuri bilan o'chirib tashlangan edi. U xotirjam edi, lekin xotirjamligi aniq majburiy edi; va ilgari sarosimasi aybining isboti sifatida keltirilgani uchun, u o'zini jasoratli ko'rinishga majburlagan edi. U sud zaliga kirganda atrofga ko'z yugurtirdi va qayerda o'tirganimizni tez topdi. Bizni ko'rganda ko'zini yosh xiralashtirganday bo'ldi, lekin u tez o'zini tutib oldi va qayg'uli mehr nigohi uning mutlaq aybsizligini tasdiqlayotganday edi.

paras.en: The trial began, and after the advocate against her had stated the charge, several witnesses were called. Several strange facts combined against her, which might have staggered anyone who had not such proof of her innocence as I had. She had been out the whole of the night on which the murder had been committed and towards morning had been perceived by a market-woman not far from the spot where the body of the murdered child had been afterwards found. The woman asked her what she did there, but she looked very strangely and only returned a confused and unintelligible answer. She returned to the house about eight o’clock, and when one inquired where she had passed the night, she replied that she had been looking for the child and demanded earnestly if anything had been heard concerning him.
paras.uz: Sud boshlandi va unga qarshi advokat ayblovni bayon qilgandan keyin bir nechta guvoh chaqirildi. Unga qarshi bir nechta g'alati faktlar birlashdi, ular menda bo'lgani kabi uning aybsizligining isbotiga ega bo'lmagan har qanday odamni ikkilantirishi mumkin edi. U qotillik sodir etilgan tun bo'yi tashqarida bo'lgan va tongga yaqin uni o'ldirilgan bolaning jasadi keyinroq topilgan joydan unchalik uzoq bo'lmagan yerda bir bozorchi ayol ko'rgan. Ayol undan u yerda nima qilayotganini so'ragan, lekin u juda g'alati qaragan va faqat chalkash va tushunarsiz javob qaytargan. U uyga taxminan soat sakkizda qaytgan va kimdir tunni qayerda o'tkazganini so'raganda, bolani qidirib yurganini aytgan va u haqda biror narsa eshitildimi, deb astoydil so'ragan.

paras.en: When shown the body, she fell into violent hysterics and kept her bed for several days. The picture was then produced which the servant had found in her pocket; and when Elizabeth, in a faltering voice, proved that it was the same which, an hour before the child had been missed, she had placed round his neck, a murmur of horror and indignation filled the court.
paras.uz: Unga jasadni ko'rsatishganda, u qattiq isteriyaga tushgan va bir necha kun to'shakda yotgan. Keyin xizmatkor uning cho'ntagidan topgan surat ko'rsatildi; va Elizabet titroq ovozda bu bola yo'qolishidan bir soat oldin o'zi uning bo'yniga taqib qo'ygan aynan o'sha surat ekanini isbotlaganda, sud zalini dahshat va g'azab shivirlari to'ldirdi.

paras.en: Justine was called on for her defence. As the trial had proceeded, her countenance had altered. Surprise, horror, and misery were strongly expressed. Sometimes she struggled with her tears, but when she was desired to plead, she collected her powers and spoke in an audible although variable voice.
paras.uz: Jastinga o'zini himoya qilish uchun so'z berildi. Sud davom etgan sari uning chehrasi o'zgargan edi. Hayrat, dahshat va baxtsizlik kuchli ifodalanardi. Ba'zan u ko'z yoshlari bilan kurashardi, lekin undan himoya nutqi so'ralganda, kuchlarini yig'ib, eshitiladigan, garchi o'zgaruvchan bo'lsa ham, ovozda gapirdi.

paras.en: “God knows,” she said, “how entirely I am innocent. But I do not pretend that my protestations should acquit me; I rest my innocence on a plain and simple explanation of the facts which have been adduced against me, and I hope the character I have always borne will incline my judges to a favourable interpretation where any circumstance appears doubtful or suspicious.”
paras.uz: «Xudo biladi, — dedi u, — men qanchalik butunlay aybsizman. Lekin norozilik bildirishlarim meni oqlashi kerak deb da'vo qilmayman; men aybsizligimni menga qarshi keltirilgan faktlarning aniq va oddiy izohiga tayantiraman va umid qilamanki, doim saqlab kelgan obro'yim har qanday holat shubhali yoki gumonli ko'ringan joyda sudyalarimni ijobiy talqinga moyil qiladi.»

paras.en: She then related that, by the permission of Elizabeth, she had passed the evening of the night on which the murder had been committed at the house of an aunt at Chêne, a village situated at about a league from Geneva. On her return, at about nine o’clock, she met a man who asked her if she had seen anything of the child who was lost. She was alarmed by this account and passed several hours in looking for him, when the gates of Geneva were shut, and she was forced to remain several hours of the night in a barn belonging to a cottage, being unwilling to call up the inhabitants, to whom she was well known. Most of the night she spent here watching; towards morning she believed that she slept for a few minutes; some steps disturbed her, and she awoke.
paras.uz: Keyin u Elizabetning ruxsati bilan qotillik sodir etilgan tunning oqshomini Jenevadan taxminan bir liga uzoqlikdagi Shen qishlog'idagi xolasining uyida o'tkazganini aytib berdi. Taxminan soat to'qqizda qaytayotganida unga bir odam uchragan va yo'qolgan bola haqida biror narsa ko'rdingmi, deb so'ragan. Bu xabardan u xavotirga tushgan va uni qidirib bir necha soat o'tkazgan, shu orada Jeneva darvozalari yopilgan va u o'zini yaxshi taniydigan aholini uyg'otishni istamay, tunning bir necha soatini bir kulbaga tegishli omborxonada qolishga majbur bo'lgan. Tunning ko'p qismini u yerda bedor o'tkazgan; tongga yaqin bir necha daqiqa uxlab qolgandek bo'lgan; qandaydir qadam tovushlari uni bezovta qilgan va u uyg'ongan.

paras.en: It was dawn, and she quitted her asylum, that she might again endeavour to find my brother. If she had gone near the spot where his body lay, it was without her knowledge. That she had been bewildered when questioned by the market-woman was not surprising, since she had passed a sleepless night and the fate of poor William was yet uncertain. Concerning the picture she could give no account.
paras.uz: Tong otayotgan edi va u ukamni yana topishga harakat qilish uchun boshpanasini tark etgan. Agar u uning jasadi yotgan joy yaqiniga borgan bo'lsa, buni bilmagan. Bozorchi ayol so'raganda dovdirab qolgani ajablanarli emas edi, chunki u tunni uyqusiz o'tkazgan va bechora Uilyamning taqdiri hali noma'lum edi. Surat haqida u hech qanday izoh bera olmadi.

paras.en: “I know,” continued the unhappy victim, “how heavily and fatally this one circumstance weighs against me, but I have no power of explaining it; and when I have expressed my utter ignorance, I am only left to conjecture concerning the probabilities by which it might have been placed in my pocket. But here also I am checked. I believe that I have no enemy on earth, and none surely would have been so wicked as to destroy me wantonly. Did the murderer place it there? I know of no opportunity afforded him for so doing; or, if I had, why should he have stolen the jewel, to part with it again so soon?
paras.uz: «Bilaman, — davom etdi baxtsiz qurbon, — bu yagona holat menga qarshi qanchalik og'ir va halokatli ta'sir qiladi, lekin uni tushuntirishga qodir emasman; va mutlaq bexabarligimni bildirganimdan keyin, faqat u cho'ntagimga qanday ehtimollar bilan qo'yilgan bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida taxmin qilishim qoladi. Lekin bu yerda ham to'xtab qolaman. Ishonamanki, yer yuzida dushmanim yo'q va hech kim meni bekordan-bekorga yo'q qiladigan darajada yovuz bo'lmasdi. Uni qotil qo'ydimi? Unga buning uchun imkoniyat berilganini bilmayman; yoki bo'lgan taqdirda ham, nega u qimmatbaho buyumni shunchalik tez yana qo'ldan chiqarish uchun o'g'irlaydi?

paras.en: “I commit my cause to the justice of my judges, yet I see no room for hope. I beg permission to have a few witnesses examined concerning my character, and if their testimony shall not overweigh my supposed guilt, I must be condemned, although I would pledge my salvation on my innocence.”
paras.uz: Ishimni sudyalarimning adolatiga topshiraman, lekin umid uchun joy ko'rmayapman. Obro'yim haqida bir nechta guvohni so'roq qilishga ruxsat so'rayman, va agar ularning guvohligi taxmin qilingan aybimdan og'ir kelmasa, men hukm qilinishim kerak, garchi aybsizligim uchun najotimni garovga qo'yishga tayyor bo'lsam ham.»

paras.en: Several witnesses were called who had known her for many years, and they spoke well of her; but fear and hatred of the crime of which they supposed her guilty rendered them timorous and unwilling to come forward. Elizabeth saw even this last resource, her excellent dispositions and irreproachable conduct, about to fail the accused, when, although violently agitated, she desired permission to address the court.
paras.uz: Uni ko'p yillardan beri bilgan bir nechta guvoh chaqirildi va ular u haqda yaxshi gapirishdi; lekin ular uni aybdor deb taxmin qilgan jinoyatdan qo'rquv va nafrat ularni tortinchoq va oldinga chiqishni istamaydigan qildi. Elizabet hatto bu so'nggi chora — ayblanuvchining a'lo fe'l-atvori va beayb xulqi ham uni tark etay deb turganini ko'rib, qattiq hayajonlangan bo'lsa ham, sudga murojaat qilishga ruxsat so'radi.

paras.en: “I am,” said she, “the cousin of the unhappy child who was murdered, or rather his sister, for I was educated by and have lived with his parents ever since and even long before his birth. It may therefore be judged indecent in me to come forward on this occasion, but when I see a fellow creature about to perish through the cowardice of her pretended friends, I wish to be allowed to speak, that I may say what I know of her character. I am well acquainted with the accused. I have lived in the same house with her, at one time for five and at another for nearly two years. During all that period she appeared to me the most amiable and benevolent of human creatures.
paras.uz: «Men, — dedi u, — o'ldirilgan baxtsiz bolaning amakivachchasiman, yaxshisi, uning opasiman, chunki men uning ota-onasi tomonidan tarbiyalanganman va u tug'ilishidan ancha oldindan beri ular bilan yashab kelaman. Shuning uchun bu holatda oldinga chiqishim nomunosib deb hisoblanishi mumkin, lekin men hamjinsim o'zini do'st deb ko'rsatganlarning qo'rqoqligi tufayli halok bo'lay deb turganini ko'rganimda, uning fe'l-atvori haqida bilganlarimni aytishim uchun gapirishga ruxsat berilishini istayman. Men ayblanuvchini yaxshi bilaman. Men u bilan bir uyda bir vaqt besh yil, boshqa vaqt deyarli ikki yil yashaganman. Shu butun davr mobaynida u menga insonlarning eng yoqimtoyi va eng xayrixohi bo'lib ko'rindi.

paras.en: She nursed Madame Frankenstein, my aunt, in her last illness, with the greatest affection and care and afterwards attended her own mother during a tedious illness, in a manner that excited the admiration of all who knew her, after which she again lived in my uncle’s house, where she was beloved by all the family. She was warmly attached to the child who is now dead and acted towards him like a most affectionate mother. For my own part, I do not hesitate to say that, notwithstanding all the evidence produced against her, I believe and rely on her perfect innocence. She had no temptation for such an action; as to the bauble on which the chief proof rests, if she had earnestly desired it, I should have willingly given it to her, so much do I esteem and value her.”
paras.uz: U xolam Frankenshteyn xonimga oxirgi kasalligida eng katta mehr va g'amxo'rlik bilan qaradi, keyin o'z onasiga uzoq davom etgan kasalligida uni bilgan hammani hayratga solgan tarzda qaradi, shundan keyin yana amakimning uyida yashadi, u yerda uni butun oila sevardi. U hozir o'lgan bolaga qattiq bog'langan edi va unga eng mehribon onadek muomala qilardi. O'z tomonimdan aytishdan tortinmaymanki, unga qarshi keltirilgan barcha dalillarga qaramay, men uning mutlaq aybsizligiga ishonaman va unga tayanaman. Unda bunday harakat uchun hech qanday vasvasa yo'q edi; asosiy dalil tayangan o'sha bezakka kelsak, agar u uni astoydil xohlaganida, men uni bajonidil unga bergan bo'lardim — men uni shunchalik hurmat qilaman va qadrlayman.»

paras.en: A murmur of approbation followed Elizabeth’s simple and powerful appeal, but it was excited by her generous interference, and not in favour of poor Justine, on whom the public indignation was turned with renewed violence, charging her with the blackest ingratitude. She herself wept as Elizabeth spoke, but she did not answer. My own agitation and anguish was extreme during the whole trial. I believed in her innocence; I knew it. Could the dæmon who had (I did not for a minute doubt) murdered my brother also in his hellish sport have betrayed the innocent to death and ignominy? I could not sustain the horror of my situation, and when I perceived that the popular voice and the countenances of the judges had already condemned my unhappy victim, I rushed out of the court in agony. The tortures of the accused did not equal mine; she was sustained by innocence, but the fangs of remorse tore my bosom and would not forgo their hold.
paras.uz: Elizabetning oddiy va kuchli murojaatidan keyin ma'qullash shivirlari eshitildi, lekin ular uning saxiy aralashuvi tufayli qo'zg'algan edi, bechora Jastin foydasiga emas; aksincha, jamoatchilik g'azabi uni eng qora noshukurlikda ayblab, yangilangan shiddat bilan unga qarshi qaratildi. Elizabet gapirayotganda uning o'zi yig'ladi, lekin javob bermadi. Butun sud davomida mening hayajonim va iztirobim haddan tashqari edi. Men uning aybsizligiga ishonardim; buni bilardim. Ukamni o'ldirgan (bunga bir daqiqa ham shubha qilmasdim) iblis o'zining do'zaxiy o'yinida aybsizni ham o'lim va sharmandalikka sotib qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkinmi? Men ahvolimning dahshatiga bardosh bera olmadim va xalqning ovozi va sudyalarning chehralari baxtsiz qurbonimni allaqachon hukm qilganini payqaganimda, iztirob ichida sud zalidan otilib chiqdim. Ayblanuvchining qiynoqlari menikiga teng emas edi; uni aybsizlik qo'llab-quvvatlardi, mening ko'kragimni esa pushaymonlik tishlari yirtar va changalini bo'shatmasdi.

paras.en: I passed a night of unmingled wretchedness. In the morning I went to the court; my lips and throat were parched. I dared not ask the fatal question, but I was known, and the officer guessed the cause of my visit. The ballots had been thrown; they were all black, and Justine was condemned.
paras.uz: Tunni hech narsa aralashmagan baxtsizlikda o'tkazdim. Ertalab sudga bordim; lablarim va tomog'im qaqrab ketgan edi. Halokatli savolni berishga jur'at etmadim, lekin meni tanishardi va ofitser kelishim sababini taxmin qildi. Ovoz berish sharlari tashlangan edi; ularning hammasi qora edi va Jastin hukm qilindi.

paras.en: I cannot pretend to describe what I then felt. I had before experienced sensations of horror, and I have endeavoured to bestow upon them adequate expressions, but words cannot convey an idea of the heart-sickening despair that I then endured. The person to whom I addressed myself added that Justine had already confessed her guilt. “That evidence,” he observed, “was hardly required in so glaring a case, but I am glad of it, and, indeed, none of our judges like to condemn a criminal upon circumstantial evidence, be it ever so decisive.”
paras.uz: O'shanda nimani his qilganimni ta'riflay olaman deb da'vo qila olmayman. Ilgari ham dahshat tuyg'ularini boshdan kechirgan edim va ularga munosib ifoda berishga harakat qildim, lekin so'zlar o'shanda chidagan yurakni ezuvchi umidsizlik haqida tasavvur bera olmaydi. Men murojaat qilgan kishi Jastin allaqachon aybini tan olganini qo'shimcha qildi. «Bunday ravshan ishda bu dalil deyarli kerak emas edi, — dedi u, — lekin men undan xursandman, aslida sudyalarimizning hech biri jinoyatchini bilvosita dalillar asosida, ular qanchalik hal qiluvchi bo'lmasin, hukm qilishni yoqtirmaydi.»

paras.en: This was strange and unexpected intelligence; what could it mean? Had my eyes deceived me? And was I really as mad as the whole world would believe me to be if I disclosed the object of my suspicions? I hastened to return home, and Elizabeth eagerly demanded the result.
paras.uz: Bu g'alati va kutilmagan xabar edi; bu nimani anglatishi mumkin? Ko'zlarim meni aldadimi? Agar gumonim ob'ektini oshkor qilsam, butun dunyo meni qanchalik telba deb hisoblasa, men haqiqatan ham shunchalik telbamanmi? Uyga qaytishga shoshildim va Elizabet natijani ishtiyoq bilan so'radi.

paras.en: “My cousin,” replied I, “it is decided as you may have expected; all judges had rather that ten innocent should suffer than that one guilty should escape. But she has confessed.”
paras.uz: «Amakivachcham, — javob berdim, — sen kutganingdek hal qilindi; barcha sudyalar bitta aybdorning qochib ketishidan ko'ra o'nta aybsizning jabr ko'rishini afzal ko'rishadi. Lekin u aybini tan olibdi.»

paras.en: This was a dire blow to poor Elizabeth, who had relied with firmness upon Justine’s innocence. “Alas!” said she. “How shall I ever again believe in human goodness? Justine, whom I loved and esteemed as my sister, how could she put on those smiles of innocence only to betray? Her mild eyes seemed incapable of any severity or guile, and yet she has committed a murder.”
paras.uz: Bu Jastinning aybsizligiga qat'iy ishongan bechora Elizabet uchun dahshatli zarba bo'ldi. «Afsus! — dedi u. — Endi qanday qilib yana inson ezguligiga ishonaman? Men singlimdek sevgan va hurmat qilgan Jastin qanday qilib faqat sotish uchun o'sha beg'uborlik tabassumlarini kiyib yurgan? Uning muloyim ko'zlari hech qanday qattiqlik yoki makrga qodir emasdek tuyulardi, lekin u qotillik qilibdi.»

paras.en: Soon after we heard that the poor victim had expressed a desire to see my cousin. My father wished her not to go but said that he left it to her own judgment and feelings to decide. “Yes,” said Elizabeth, “I will go, although she is guilty; and you, Victor, shall accompany me; I cannot go alone.” The idea of this visit was torture to me, yet I could not refuse.
paras.uz: Ko'p o'tmay bechora qurbon amakivachchamni ko'rish istagini bildirganini eshitdik. Otam uning bormasligini istadi, lekin qaror qabul qilishni uning o'z mulohazasi va his-tuyg'ulariga qoldirishini aytdi. «Ha, — dedi Elizabet, — u aybdor bo'lsa ham, boraman; sen esa, Viktor, menga hamroh bo'lasan; yolg'iz bora olmayman.» Bu tashrif haqidagi fikr men uchun qiynoq edi, lekin rad eta olmadim.

paras.en: We entered the gloomy prison chamber and beheld Justine sitting on some straw at the farther end; her hands were manacled, and her head rested on her knees. She rose on seeing us enter, and when we were left alone with her, she threw herself at the feet of Elizabeth, weeping bitterly. My cousin wept also.
paras.uz: Biz g'amgin qamoqxona xonasiga kirdik va Jastinni narigi chetda somon ustida o'tirgan holda ko'rdik; qo'llari kishanlangan, boshi tizzalariga qo'yilgan edi. Bizni kirganimizni ko'rib, u o'rnidan turdi va biz u bilan yolg'iz qolganimizda, achchiq yig'lab Elizabetning oyoqlariga o'zini tashladi. Amakivachcham ham yig'ladi.

paras.en: “Oh, Justine!” said she. “Why did you rob me of my last consolation? I relied on your innocence, and although I was then very wretched, I was not so miserable as I am now.”
paras.uz: «Oh, Jastin! — dedi u. — Nega meni so'nggi tasallimdan mahrum qilding? Men sening aybsizligingga ishongan edim va o'shanda juda baxtsiz bo'lsam ham, hozirgidek ayanchli emas edim.»

paras.en: “And do you also believe that I am so very, very wicked? Do you also join with my enemies to crush me, to condemn me as a murderer?” Her voice was suffocated with sobs.
paras.uz: «Siz ham meni shunchalik, shunchalik yovuz deb ishonasizmi? Siz ham meni ezish, qotil sifatida hukm qilish uchun dushmanlarimga qo'shilasizmi?» Uning ovozi ho'ngrashlardan bo'g'ilib qoldi.

paras.en: “Rise, my poor girl,” said Elizabeth; “why do you kneel, if you are innocent? I am not one of your enemies, I believed you guiltless, notwithstanding every evidence, until I heard that you had yourself declared your guilt. That report, you say, is false; and be assured, dear Justine, that nothing can shake my confidence in you for a moment, but your own confession.”
paras.uz: «Tur, bechora qizim, — dedi Elizabet, — agar aybsiz bo'lsang, nega tiz cho'kasan? Men dushmanlaringdan biri emasman, sen o'zing aybingni bildirganingni eshitmagunimcha, barcha dalillarga qaramay seni aybsiz deb ishongan edim. Sen bu xabar yolg'on deyapsan; ishonchim komil bo'lsin, aziz Jastin, sening o'z e'tirofingdan boshqa hech narsa senga bo'lgan ishonchimni bir lahza ham silkita olmaydi.»

paras.en: “I did confess, but I confessed a lie. I confessed, that I might obtain absolution; but now that falsehood lies heavier at my heart than all my other sins. The God of heaven forgive me! Ever since I was condemned, my confessor has besieged me; he threatened and menaced, until I almost began to think that I was the monster that he said I was. He threatened excommunication and hell fire in my last moments if I continued obdurate. Dear lady, I had none to support me; all looked on me as a wretch doomed to ignominy and perdition. What could I do? In an evil hour I subscribed to a lie; and now only am I truly miserable.”
paras.uz: «Men tan oldim, lekin yolg'onni tan oldim. Gunohlarim kechirilishi uchun tan oldim; lekin endi o'sha yolg'on yuragimda boshqa barcha gunohlarimdan og'irroq yotibdi. Osmon Xudosi meni kechirsin! Hukm qilinganimdan beri tavba tinglovchim meni qamal qildi; u shunchalik tahdid qildi va qo'rqitdiki, oxiri men o'zim u aytgan yirtqichman deb o'ylay boshladim. Agar qaysarligimda davom etsam, so'nggi lahzalarimda cherkovdan quvish va do'zax olovi bilan tahdid qildi. Aziz xonim, meni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan hech kim yo'q edi; hamma menga sharmandalik va halokatga mahkum bechora deb qarardi. Nima qila olardim? Yomon soatda yolg'onga imzo chekdim; va endigina chindan baxtsizman.»

paras.en: She paused, weeping, and then continued, “I thought with horror, my sweet lady, that you should believe your Justine, whom your blessed aunt had so highly honoured, and whom you loved, was a creature capable of a crime which none but the devil himself could have perpetrated. Dear William! dearest blessed child! I soon shall see you again in heaven, where we shall all be happy; and that consoles me, going as I am to suffer ignominy and death.”
paras.uz: U yig'lab to'xtadi, keyin davom etdi: «Shirin xonimim, sizning muborak xolangiz shunchalik hurmat qilgan va siz sevgan Jastiningizni faqat shaytonning o'zi qila oladigan jinoyatga qodir mavjudot deb ishonasiz, deb dahshat bilan o'yladim. Aziz Uilyam! eng aziz muborak bola! Tez orada seni yana jannatda ko'raman, u yerda hammamiz baxtli bo'lamiz; sharmandalik va o'limga borayotgan menga bu tasalli beradi.»

paras.en: “Oh, Justine! Forgive me for having for one moment distrusted you. Why did you confess? But do not mourn, dear girl. Do not fear. I will proclaim, I will prove your innocence. I will melt the stony hearts of your enemies by my tears and prayers. You shall not die! You, my playfellow, my companion, my sister, perish on the scaffold! No! No! I never could survive so horrible a misfortune.”
paras.uz: «Oh, Jastin! Bir lahza ham senga ishonmaganim uchun meni kechir. Nega tan olding? Lekin qayg'urma, aziz qiz. Qo'rqma. Men aybsizligingni e'lon qilaman, isbotlayman. Dushmanlaringning toshdek yuraklarini ko'z yoshlarim va iltijolarim bilan eritaman. Sen o'lmaysan! Sen, mening o'yindoshim, hamrohim, singlim, dorda halok bo'lasanmi! Yo'q! Yo'q! Men bunday dahshatli baxtsizlikdan keyin hech qachon tirik qola olmasdim.»

paras.en: Justine shook her head mournfully. “I do not fear to die,” she said; “that pang is past. God raises my weakness and gives me courage to endure the worst. I leave a sad and bitter world; and if you remember me and think of me as of one unjustly condemned, I am resigned to the fate awaiting me. Learn from me, dear lady, to submit in patience to the will of heaven!”
paras.uz: Jastin g'amgin bosh chayqadi. «Men o'lishdan qo'rqmayman, — dedi u, — u og'riq o'tib ketdi. Xudo zaifligimni ko'taradi va eng yomoniga chidash uchun jasorat beradi. Men g'amgin va achchiq dunyoni tark etaman; va agar meni eslasangiz va men haqimda nohaq hukm qilingan odam haqidagidek o'ylasangiz, meni kutayotgan taqdirga roziman. Mendan o'rganing, aziz xonim, osmon irodasiga sabr bilan bo'ysunishni!»

paras.en: During this conversation I had retired to a corner of the prison room, where I could conceal the horrid anguish that possessed me. Despair! Who dared talk of that? The poor victim, who on the morrow was to pass the awful boundary between life and death, felt not, as I did, such deep and bitter agony. I gnashed my teeth and ground them together, uttering a groan that came from my inmost soul. Justine started. When she saw who it was, she approached me and said, “Dear sir, you are very kind to visit me; you, I hope, do not believe that I am guilty?”
paras.uz: Bu suhbat davomida men qamoqxona xonasining bir burchagiga chekingan edim, u yerda meni qamrab olgan dahshatli iztirobni yashira olardim. Umidsizlik! Bu haqda kim gapirishga jur'at etdi? Ertaga hayot va o'lim o'rtasidagi dahshatli chegaradan o'tishi kerak bo'lgan bechora qurbon men his qilgandek chuqur va achchiq azobni his qilmasdi. Men tishlarimni g'ijirlatib, ularni bir-biriga ezib, qalbimning eng ichkarisidan chiqqan ingroqni chiqardim. Jastin cho'chib ketdi. Kim ekanini ko'rgach, u menga yaqinlashib dedi: «Aziz janob, meni ko'rgani kelganingiz uchun juda mehribonsiz; umid qilamanki, siz meni aybdor deb ishonmaysiz-a?»

paras.en: I could not answer. “No, Justine,” said Elizabeth; “he is more convinced of your innocence than I was, for even when he heard that you had confessed, he did not credit it.”
paras.uz: Men javob bera olmadim. «Yo'q, Jastin, — dedi Elizabet, — u sening aybsizligingga mendan ham ko'proq amin, chunki hatto sen tan olganingni eshitganda ham, bunga ishonmadi.»

paras.en: “I truly thank him. In these last moments I feel the sincerest gratitude towards those who think of me with kindness. How sweet is the affection of others to such a wretch as I am! It removes more than half my misfortune, and I feel as if I could die in peace now that my innocence is acknowledged by you, dear lady, and your cousin.”
paras.uz: «Undan chin dildan minnatdorman. Bu so'nggi lahzalarda men haqimda mehr bilan o'ylaydiganlarga eng samimiy minnatdorlik his qilaman. Men kabi bechoraga boshqalarning mehri qanchalik shirin! U baxtsizligimning yarmidan ko'pini olib tashlaydi va endi aybsizligimni siz, aziz xonim, va amakivachchangiz tan olganingiz uchun tinch o'la oladigandek his qilaman.»

paras.en: Thus the poor sufferer tried to comfort others and herself. She indeed gained the resignation she desired. But I, the true murderer, felt the never-dying worm alive in my bosom, which allowed of no hope or consolation. Elizabeth also wept and was unhappy, but hers also was the misery of innocence, which, like a cloud that passes over the fair moon, for a while hides but cannot tarnish its brightness. Anguish and despair had penetrated into the core of my heart; I bore a hell within me which nothing could extinguish. We stayed several hours with Justine, and it was with great difficulty that Elizabeth could tear herself away. “I wish,” cried she, “that I were to die with you; I cannot live in this world of misery.”
paras.uz: Shunday qilib bechora jabrdiyda boshqalarni va o'zini yupatishga urindi. U haqiqatan ham istagan taslimlikka erishdi. Lekin men, haqiqiy qotil, ko'kragimda hech qanday umid yoki tasalliga yo'l qo'ymaydigan hech qachon o'lmaydigan qurtni tirik his qildim. Elizabet ham yig'ladi va baxtsiz edi, lekin uniki ham aybsizlik baxtsizligi edi, u go'zal oy ustidan o'tadigan bulutdek bir muddat yashiradi, lekin uning yorqinligini xiralashtira olmaydi. Iztirob va umidsizlik yuragimning tubigacha kirib borgan edi; ichimda hech narsa o'chira olmaydigan do'zaxni ko'tarib yurardim. Biz Jastin bilan bir necha soat qoldik va Elizabet undan katta qiyinchilik bilan ajralib chiqdi. «Qaniydi, — deb qichqirdi u, — sen bilan birga o'lsam; men bu baxtsizlik dunyosida yashay olmayman.»

paras.en: Justine assumed an air of cheerfulness, while she with difficulty repressed her bitter tears. She embraced Elizabeth and said in a voice of half-suppressed emotion, “Farewell, sweet lady, dearest Elizabeth, my beloved and only friend; may heaven, in its bounty, bless and preserve you; may this be the last misfortune that you will ever suffer! Live, and be happy, and make others so.”
paras.uz: Jastin achchiq ko'z yoshlarini zo'rg'a bosib, quvnoq qiyofaga kirdi. U Elizabetni quchoqladi va yarim bosilgan hayajonli ovozda dedi: «Xayr, shirin xonim, eng aziz Elizabet, mening sevimli va yagona do'stim; osmon o'z saxovati bilan sizni duo qilsin va asrasin; bu siz boshdan kechiradigan so'nggi baxtsizlik bo'lsin! Yashang, baxtli bo'ling va boshqalarni ham baxtli qiling.»

paras.en: And on the morrow Justine died. Elizabeth’s heart-rending eloquence failed to move the judges from their settled conviction in the criminality of the saintly sufferer. My passionate and indignant appeals were lost upon them. And when I received their cold answers and heard the harsh, unfeeling reasoning of these men, my purposed avowal died away on my lips. Thus I might proclaim myself a madman, but not revoke the sentence passed upon my wretched victim. She perished on the scaffold as a murderess!
paras.uz: Va ertasi kuni Jastin o'ldi. Elizabetning yurakni ezuvchi notiqligi sudyalarni avliyo jabrdiydaning aybdorligiga bo'lgan qat'iy ishonchidan qaytara olmadi. Mening ehtirosli va g'azabli murojaatlarim ularga ta'sir qilmadi. Va ularning sovuq javoblarini olib, bu odamlarning qo'pol, hissiz mulohazalarini eshitganimda, niyat qilgan e'tirofim labimda o'lib qoldi. Shunday qilib men o'zimni telba deb e'lon qilishim mumkin edi, lekin baxtsiz qurbonimga chiqarilgan hukmni bekor qila olmasdim. U qotil sifatida dorda halok bo'ldi!

paras.en: From the tortures of my own heart, I turned to contemplate the deep and voiceless grief of my Elizabeth. This also was my doing! And my father’s woe, and the desolation of that late so smiling home all was the work of my thrice-accursed hands! Ye weep, unhappy ones, but these are not your last tears! Again shall you raise the funeral wail, and the sound of your lamentations shall again and again be heard! Frankenstein, your son, your kinsman, your early, much-loved friend; he who would spend each vital drop of blood for your sakes, who has no thought nor sense of joy except as it is mirrored also in your dear countenances, who would fill the air with blessings and spend his life in serving you—he bids you weep, to shed countless tears; happy beyond his hopes, if thus inexorable fate be satisfied, and if the destruction pause before the peace of the grave have succeeded to your sad torments!
paras.uz: O'z yuragimning qiynoqlaridan men Elizabetimning chuqur va sassiz qayg'usini tomosha qilishga o'girildim. Bu ham mening ishim edi! Otamning g'ami va yaqindagina shunchalik jilmayib turgan uyning vayronligi — hammasi mening uch marta la'natlangan qo'llarimning ishi edi! Yig'laysizlar, baxtsizlar, lekin bu sizning oxirgi ko'z yoshlaringiz emas! Yana dafn faryodini ko'tarasizlar va nolalaringiz ovozi yana va yana eshitiladi! Frankenshteyn, sizning o'g'lingiz, qarindoshingiz, erta, suyukli do'stingiz; siz uchun har bir hayotiy qon tomchisini sarflaydigan, quvonchni faqat u sizning aziz chehralaringizda aks etgandagina o'ylaydigan va his qiladigan, havoni duolar bilan to'ldiradigan va hayotini sizga xizmat qilishga sarflaydigan kishi — u sizni yig'lashga, son-sanoqsiz ko'z yoshlarini to'kishga undaydi; agar shu bilan murosasiz taqdir qanoat qilsa va halokat qabr tinchligi g'amgin azoblaringiz o'rnini egallashidan oldin to'xtasa, u umidlaridan ham ortiq baxtli bo'lardi!

paras.en: Thus spoke my prophetic soul, as, torn by remorse, horror, and despair, I beheld those I loved spend vain sorrow upon the graves of William and Justine, the first hapless victims to my unhallowed arts.
paras.uz: Pushaymonlik, dahshat va umidsizlikdan yirtilgan holda men sevganlarim nopok san'atlarimning ilk baxtsiz qurbonlari — Uilyam va Jastinning qabrlari ustida behuda qayg'u to'kayotganini ko'rarkanman, bashoratchi qalbim shunday gapirdi.

paras.en: Nothing is more painful to the human mind than, after the feelings have been worked up by a quick succession of events, the dead calmness of inaction and certainty which follows and deprives the soul both of hope and fear. Justine died, she rested, and I was alive. The blood flowed freely in my veins, but a weight of despair and remorse pressed on my heart which nothing could remove. Sleep fled from my eyes; I wandered like an evil spirit, for I had committed deeds of mischief beyond description horrible, and more, much more (I persuaded myself) was yet behind. Yet my heart overflowed with kindness and the love of virtue. I had begun life with benevolent intentions and thirsted for the moment when I should put them in practice and make myself useful to my fellow beings. Now all was blasted; instead of that serenity of conscience which allowed me to look back upon the past with self-satisfaction, and from thence to gather promise of new hopes, I was seized by remorse and the sense of guilt, which hurried me away to a hell of intense tortures such as no language can describe.
paras.uz: Voqealarning tez ketma-ketligi bilan his-tuyg'ular qo'zg'algandan keyin keladigan va ruhni ham umiddan, ham qo'rquvdan mahrum qiladigan harakatsizlik va aniqlikning o'lik sokinligidan ko'ra inson aqli uchun og'riqliroq narsa yo'q. Jastin o'ldi, u orom topdi, men esa tirik edim. Qon tomirlarimda erkin oqardi, lekin yuragimni hech narsa olib tashlay olmaydigan umidsizlik va pushaymonlik yuki ezardi. Uyqu ko'zlarimdan qochdi; men yovuz ruhdek kezib yurardim, chunki ta'riflab bo'lmas darajada dahshatli yovuz ishlar qilgan edim va (o'zimni ishontirardimki) hali bundan ko'p, ancha ko'p narsa oldinda edi. Shunga qaramay yuragim mehribonlik va fazilatga muhabbatga to'lib-toshardi. Men hayotni xayrixoh niyatlar bilan boshlagan va ularni amalda qo'llash va o'zimni hamjinslarimga foydali qilish lahzasiga tashna edim. Endi hammasi barbod bo'ldi; o'tmishga o'zimdan mamnun holda orqaga qarashga va undan yangi umidlar va'dasini yig'ishga imkon beradigan vijdon osoyishtaligi o'rniga meni pushaymonlik va ayb tuyg'usi qamrab oldi, ular meni hech qanday til ta'riflay olmaydigan kuchli qiynoqlar do'zaxiga sudrab ketdi.

paras.en: This state of mind preyed upon my health, which had perhaps never entirely recovered from the first shock it had sustained. I shunned the face of man; all sound of joy or complacency was torture to me; solitude was my only consolation—deep, dark, deathlike solitude.
paras.uz: Ruhning bu holati sog'lig'imni yemirdi, u balki o'zi olgan birinchi zarbadan hech qachon to'liq tiklanmagan edi. Men inson yuzidan qochardim; quvonch yoki mamnunlikning har qanday ovozi men uchun qiynoq edi; yolg'izlik yagona tasallim edi — chuqur, qorong'i, o'limga o'xshash yolg'izlik.

paras.en: My father observed with pain the alteration perceptible in my disposition and habits and endeavoured by arguments deduced from the feelings of his serene conscience and guiltless life to inspire me with fortitude and awaken in me the courage to dispel the dark cloud which brooded over me. “Do you think, Victor,” said he, “that I do not suffer also? No one could love a child more than I loved your brother”—tears came into his eyes as he spoke—“but is it not a duty to the survivors that we should refrain from augmenting their unhappiness by an appearance of immoderate grief? It is also a duty owed to yourself, for excessive sorrow prevents improvement or enjoyment, or even the discharge of daily usefulness, without which no man is fit for society.”
paras.uz: Otam fe'l-atvorim va odatlarimdagi sezilarli o'zgarishni og'riq bilan kuzatar va sokin vijdoni va beayb hayotining tuyg'ularidan kelib chiqqan dalillar bilan menda matonat uyg'otishga va ustimda osilib turgan qora bulutni tarqatish uchun jasorat uyg'otishga harakat qilardi. «Viktor, — dedi u, — men azob chekmayman deb o'ylaysanmi? Hech kim farzandni men ukangni sevganimdan ko'ra ko'proq seva olmasdi, — gapirarkan, ko'zlariga yosh keldi, — lekin tirik qolganlarning baxtsizligini haddan tashqari qayg'u ko'rinishi bilan oshirmaslik ularga nisbatan burchimiz emasmi? Bu o'zingga nisbatan ham burch, chunki haddan tashqari qayg'u rivojlanishga yoki zavqlanishga, hatto kundalik foydali ishlarni bajarishga ham to'sqinlik qiladi, ularsiz esa hech bir inson jamiyatga yaroqli emas.»

paras.en: This advice, although good, was totally inapplicable to my case; I should have been the first to hide my grief and console my friends if remorse had not mingled its bitterness, and terror its alarm, with my other sensations. Now I could only answer my father with a look of despair and endeavour to hide myself from his view.
paras.uz: Bu maslahat, yaxshi bo'lsa ham, mening holatimga mutlaqo to'g'ri kelmasdi; agar boshqa his-tuyg'ularimga pushaymonlik o'z achchig'ini, dahshat esa o'z vahimasini aralashtirmaganida, men qayg'umni yashirib, do'stlarimni yupatadiganlarning birinchisi bo'lardim. Endi esa otamga faqat umidsizlik nigohi bilan javob berib, uning ko'zidan yashirinishga harakat qila olardim.

paras.en: About this time we retired to our house at Belrive. This change was particularly agreeable to me. The shutting of the gates regularly at ten o’clock and the impossibility of remaining on the lake after that hour had rendered our residence within the walls of Geneva very irksome to me. I was now free. Often, after the rest of the family had retired for the night, I took the boat and passed many hours upon the water. Sometimes, with my sails set, I was carried by the wind; and sometimes, after rowing into the middle of the lake, I left the boat to pursue its own course and gave way to my own miserable reflections.
paras.uz: Taxminan shu vaqtda biz Belrivdagi uyimizga chekindik. Bu o'zgarish menga ayniqsa yoqdi. Darvozalarning muntazam ravishda soat o'nda yopilishi va o'sha soatdan keyin ko'lda qolishning imkonsizligi Jeneva devorlari ichida yashashimizni men uchun juda malol qilgan edi. Endi men ozod edim. Ko'pincha oilaning qolgan a'zolari tunashga ketgandan keyin qayiqni olib, suvda ko'p soatlar o'tkazardim. Ba'zan yelkanlarimni ochib, shamol meni olib ketardi; ba'zan esa ko'lning o'rtasigacha eshkak eshib borgach, qayiqni o'z yo'liga qo'yib yuborib, o'zimning ayanchli mulohazalarimga berilardim.

paras.en: I was often tempted, when all was at peace around me, and I the only unquiet thing that wandered restless in a scene so beautiful and heavenly—if I except some bat, or the frogs, whose harsh and interrupted croaking was heard only when I approached the shore—often, I say, I was tempted to plunge into the silent lake, that the waters might close over me and my calamities for ever. But I was restrained, when I thought of the heroic and suffering Elizabeth, whom I tenderly loved, and whose existence was bound up in mine. I thought also of my father and surviving brother; should I by my base desertion leave them exposed and unprotected to the malice of the fiend whom I had let loose among them?
paras.uz: Atrofimdagi hamma narsa tinch bo'lganda va men shunchalik go'zal va samoviy manzarada bezovta kezib yurgan yagona notinch narsa bo'lganimda — agar qandaydir ko'rshapalakni yoki faqat qirg'oqqa yaqinlashganimda qo'pol va uzuq-yuluq qurillashi eshitiladigan baqalarni hisobga olmasak — ko'pincha, aytaman, sokin ko'lga sho'ng'ib ketishga vasvasaga tushardim, toki suvlar meni va baxtsizliklarimni abadiy qoplasin. Lekin men nozik sevgan va borlig'i menikiga bog'langan qahramon va azob chekayotgan Elizabetni o'ylaganimda, o'zimni tiyardim. Otamni va tirik qolgan ukamni ham o'ylardim; men tuban qochishim bilan ularni o'zim ular orasiga qo'yib yuborgan shaytonning yovuzligiga himoyasiz qoldirishim kerakmi?

paras.en: At these moments I wept bitterly and wished that peace would revisit my mind only that I might afford them consolation and happiness. But that could not be. Remorse extinguished every hope. I had been the author of unalterable evils, and I lived in daily fear lest the monster whom I had created should perpetrate some new wickedness. I had an obscure feeling that all was not over and that he would still commit some signal crime, which by its enormity should almost efface the recollection of the past. There was always scope for fear so long as anything I loved remained behind. My abhorrence of this fiend cannot be conceived. When I thought of him I gnashed my teeth, my eyes became inflamed, and I ardently wished to extinguish that life which I had so thoughtlessly bestowed.
paras.uz: Bu lahzalarda men achchiq yig'lardim va aqlimga tinchlik faqat ularga tasalli va baxt berishim uchungina qaytishini istardim. Lekin bunday bo'lishi mumkin emas edi. Pushaymonlik har qanday umidni o'chirdi. Men o'zgartirib bo'lmas yovuzliklarning muallifi bo'lgan edim va o'zim yaratgan yirtqich qandaydir yangi yovuzlik qilmasin, deb har kuni qo'rquvda yashardim. Menda hammasi tugamagan va u hali ham qandaydir ko'zga ko'rinarli jinoyat qiladi, u o'zining dahshatliligi bilan o'tmish xotirasini deyarli o'chirib yuboradi, degan noaniq tuyg'u bor edi. Men sevgan biror narsa qolgan ekan, qo'rquv uchun doim joy bor edi. Bu shaytonga bo'lgan nafratimni tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydi. U haqda o'ylaganimda tishlarimni g'ijirlatardim, ko'zlarim yonib ketardi va men shunchalik o'ylamasdan ato etgan o'sha hayotni o'chirishni qizg'in istardim.

paras.en: When I reflected on his crimes and malice, my hatred and revenge burst all bounds of moderation. I would have made a pilgrimage to the highest peak of the Andes, could I, when there, have precipitated him to their base. I wished to see him again, that I might wreak the utmost extent of abhorrence on his head and avenge the deaths of William and Justine.
paras.uz: Uning jinoyatlari va yovuzligi haqida o'ylaganimda, nafratim va qasos istagim me'yorning barcha chegaralarini buzib o'tardi. Agar u yerda uni pastga uloqtira olsam, And tog'larining eng baland cho'qqisiga ham ziyorat qilib borgan bo'lardim. Men uni yana ko'rishni istardim, toki uning boshiga nafratning eng chekka darajasini yog'dirib, Uilyam va Jastinning o'limi uchun qasos olay.

paras.en: Our house was the house of mourning. My father’s health was deeply shaken by the horror of the recent events. Elizabeth was sad and desponding; she no longer took delight in her ordinary occupations; all pleasure seemed to her sacrilege toward the dead; eternal woe and tears she then thought was the just tribute she should pay to innocence so blasted and destroyed. She was no longer that happy creature who in earlier youth wandered with me on the banks of the lake and talked with ecstasy of our future prospects. The first of those sorrows which are sent to wean us from the earth had visited her, and its dimming influence quenched her dearest smiles.
paras.uz: Uyimiz motam uyi edi. Yaqindagi voqealarning dahshati otamning sog'lig'ini qattiq larzaga soldi. Elizabet g'amgin va tushkun edi; u endi odatiy mashg'ulotlaridan zavqlanmasdi; har qanday zavq unga o'liklarga nisbatan kufrdek tuyulardi; abadiy qayg'u va ko'z yoshlari, deb o'ylardi u o'shanda, shunchalik barbod qilingan va vayron etilgan beg'uborlikka to'lashi kerak bo'lgan adolatli soliq edi. U endi ilk yoshlikda men bilan ko'l qirg'oqlarida kezib yurgan va kelajak istiqbollarimiz haqida vajd bilan gaplashgan o'sha baxtli jonzot emas edi. Bizni yerdan ajratish uchun yuboriladigan o'sha qayg'ularning birinchisi uni ziyorat qilgan edi va uning xiralashtiruvchi ta'siri eng aziz tabassumlarini o'chirib qo'ydi.

paras.en: “When I reflect, my dear cousin,” said she, “on the miserable death of Justine Moritz, I no longer see the world and its works as they before appeared to me. Before, I looked upon the accounts of vice and injustice that I read in books or heard from others as tales of ancient days or imaginary evils; at least they were remote and more familiar to reason than to the imagination; but now misery has come home, and men appear to me as monsters thirsting for each other’s blood. Yet I am certainly unjust. Everybody believed that poor girl to be guilty; and if she could have committed the crime for which she suffered, assuredly she would have been the most depraved of human creatures.
paras.uz: «Aziz amakivachcham, — dedi u, — Jastin Moritsning ayanchli o'limi haqida o'ylasam, dunyo va uning ishlarini avvalgidek ko'rmayapman. Ilgari kitoblarda o'qigan yoki boshqalardan eshitgan illat va adolatsizlik haqidagi hikoyalarga qadimiy kunlar ertaklari yoki xayoliy yovuzliklar deb qarardim; hech bo'lmasa ular uzoq va tasavvurdan ko'ra aqlga tanishroq edi; lekin endi baxtsizlik uyga kirib keldi va odamlar menga bir-birining qoniga tashna yirtqichlardek ko'rinadi. Shunga qaramay, men albatta adolatsizlik qilyapman. Hamma o'sha bechora qizni aybdor deb ishondi; va agar u azob chekkan jinoyatni sodir eta olganida edi, u, shubhasiz, insonlarning eng buzuqi bo'lardi.

paras.en: For the sake of a few jewels, to have murdered the son of her benefactor and friend, a child whom she had nursed from its birth, and appeared to love as if it had been her own! I could not consent to the death of any human being, but certainly I should have thought such a creature unfit to remain in the society of men. But she was innocent. I know, I feel she was innocent; you are of the same opinion, and that confirms me. Alas! Victor, when falsehood can look so like the truth, who can assure themselves of certain happiness? I feel as if I were walking on the edge of a precipice, towards which thousands are crowding and endeavouring to plunge me into the abyss. William and Justine were assassinated, and the murderer escapes; he walks about the world free, and perhaps respected. But even if I were condemned to suffer on the scaffold for the same crimes, I would not change places with such a wretch.”
paras.uz: Bir nechta zeb-ziynat uchun o'z xayrixohi va do'stining o'g'lini, tug'ilganidan beri o'zi boqqan va o'zinikidek sevganga o'xshagan bolani o'ldirish! Men hech bir insonning o'limiga rozi bo'la olmasdim, lekin, albatta, bunday mavjudotni odamlar jamiyatida qolishga yaroqsiz deb hisoblagan bo'lardim. Lekin u aybsiz edi. Bilaman, his qilaman, u aybsiz edi; sen ham shu fikrdasan va bu meni tasdiqlaydi. Afsus! Viktor, yolg'on haqiqatga shunchalik o'xshab ketishi mumkin ekan, kim o'zini aniq baxtga ishontira oladi?
